walkthrough.title: First Mission — Arenside Village
walkthrough.summary_id: Misi pertama Nowa sebagai anggota Watch dimulai di Desa Arenside. Di sini kamu belajar dasar bertarung dan menjelajah sambil berkenalan dengan rekan-rekan barumu.
walkthrough.summary_en: Nowa's first mission as a Watch member begins in Arenside Village. Here you learn the basics of combat and exploration while meeting your new comrades.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: The game opens with Nowa meeting his starting companions: Garr, Mio, and Lian. After the introductions, you take control of Nowa.
Follow the map marker (press X or your platform's equivalent to view the map) up toward the Village Chief's manor.
On the way up the steps you'll see Perrielle speaking with Janquis. She mentions she'll pay extra for information about the Runebarrows.
Continue uphill to the chief's house at the top. Speak with the two officers in blue uniforms waiting at the stairs: Hildi and Seign.

sections.heading: Mission Preparations
steps: After the briefing, go down the first staircase and turn left to reach the shop.
Buy Healing Herbs and Revival Medicine — healing magic is scarce early on, so stock up. Weapon upgrades here are minor, so prioritize consumables.
You can chat with villagers to learn about Arenside and the Empire-League tensions, but there's nothing to gain from conversations yet.
When ready, head south out of the village to begin your first real mission.

walkthrough.title: Into the Barrows — Northern Forest
walkthrough.summary_id: Misi resmi pertama Watch membawamu ke Hutan Utara untuk menemukan Runebarrows. Waspadalah terhadap monster liar dan jebakan kuno di dalam reruntuhan.
walkthrough.summary_en: The Watch's first official mission takes you into the Northern Forest to locate the Runebarrows. Watch out for wild monsters and ancient traps inside the ruins.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: Your first real mission takes you northeast of Arenside, marked on the map with trees and a blue exclamation point.
Travel across the field, staying along the river as your companions suggest. Cross at the fallen tree trunk serving as a bridge.
This leads to the Northern Forest, your first dungeon area outside town.

sections.heading: Exploring the Northern Forest
steps: Walk straight ahead until you spot a green spinning disk — these are save points. The game autosaves, but these also mark spots before major battles, so use them.
Check the sparkles to your left for 3 Lumber. Sparkles throughout the game hide crafting materials.
Follow the path to a chest with 6 Healing Herbs. Continue until a boulder blocks the way — a cutscene clears it.
To the left you'll find a large climbable tree trunk. Climb it, then detour north down a descending path to a chest with a Ruby Ring. Equip it from the menu since nobody has accessories yet.
Return to the ascending path and stop at the odd device in the clearing. After the cutscene, keep crossing the treetops.
You'll reach another save point and a chest with 400 baqua. Get ready — a boss is ahead.
Head right and descend through the fog. At the bottom, a cutscene leads into your first boss: the Forest Eater.

sections.heading: Boss Fight: Forest Eater
steps: Open with Garr's Rune-Lens ability Double Slash to raise his physical attack.
The boss's Stomach Acid Shot will drop a hero to about half HP. When it lands, use Defend on that character's turn and have someone like Mio or Hildi heal with a Healing Herb.
Keep chipping away and you'll win.
Afterward, interact with the nearby device to clear the fog. Before heading back up, grab the chest to the north with 2 Revival Medicines.
Return to the save point, then ascend toward the vault-like gate. Check left first for a chest with a Tricorne Hat (a defense upgrade for Lian or Mio).
Enter the gate to the Northern Runebarrows. A cutscene introduces the Primal Lens. Save, then head left to continue.

walkthrough.title: Search the Barrows — Northern Runebarrows
walkthrough.summary_id: Jelajahi kedalaman Northern Runebarrows bersama Seign. Misteri Primal Lens mulai terkuak, tapi reruntuhannya menyimpan bahaya yang jauh lebih besar.
walkthrough.summary_en: Explore the depths of the Northern Runebarrows alongside Seign. The mystery of the Primal Lens starts to unfold, but far greater dangers hide in the ruins.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: From the main room with the save point, head left. At the crossroads go north — the room to the left is sealed for now.

Reach the black sphere and a short dialogue hints the crossroads room is now open. Go back and step on the three platforms, pressing the confirm button on each in this order: circle, triangle, square.
Inside you'll mostly find rubble, plus a chest with a Tanzanite Ring (boosts magic attack — useful later).
Backtrack to the sphere area and find a similar door. Before opening it, go south down the hall for a chest with 400 baqua.
Return to the objective marker and use the same circle-triangle-square order to open the door.
At the next crossroads, head south for another 400 baqua chest, then go back up and right to stay on the main path.

sections.heading: Nowa and Seign Alone
steps: After a cutscene, Nowa and Seign are separated from the party. Head right once the rubble clears.
After some scripted fights, check a nook to the right for a chest with 6 Healing Herbs. Heal up — both are weak after the Spy Orb encounter.
Follow the path up some stairs for a Hero Combo tutorial. These use both characters' turns but hit hard.
At a crossroads, go as far north as possible for a chest with 2 Revival Medicines.
Head back toward the objective — another black sphere. Before activating it, go further right for a 400 baqua chest.
Activate the sphere, then approach the familiar door. This time the order is square, circle, triangle (getting it wrong triggers amusing dialogue from Seign).
Go through, save, then head back to the starting room. A cutscene activates the primal lens, and you face the Golem Pulverizer.

sections.heading: Boss Fight: Golem Pulverizer
steps: You start with only Nowa and Seign — focus purely on survival until the rest of the team arrives.
Once reunited, boost Garr's attack with Double Slash whenever possible. Individual Rune-Lens techniques and normal attacks outdamage the Nowa-Seign Hero Combo here.
Watch for the Golem's multi-target Sweep. After it hits, use Hildi's Recovery Wave to heal everyone — but MP is limited, so spend it wisely.
Mid-fight you'll unlock gimmicks: extra actions replacing normal attacks. Here you can hide behind debris.
Use the hide gimmick after the Golem uses Lock-On (a reticle appears over targeted characters, also shown next to their names). Hide with the targeted characters' turns.
After its Destruction Ray, the Golem needs a turn to recharge — that's your window for heavy attacks.
Defeat it to end the prologue.

walkthrough.title: The Watch Captain's First Job — Eltisweiss
walkthrough.summary_id: Enam bulan berlalu dan Nowa kini menjabat Kapten Watch. Tugas pertamamu membawamu berkeliling kota Eltisweiss dan menangani masalah para warga.
walkthrough.summary_en: Six months have passed and Nowa is now the Watch Captain. Your first assignment sends you around the town of Eltisweiss handling the locals' problems.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: Six months pass after the prologue. Back at the Heroes' Den, Garr makes Nowa the acting captain of the Watch.
You can now recruit freely. To advance the story from Eltisweiss, you need three new Watch members.
Before leaving, check the upper rooms of the Heroes' Den — the leftmost room has a chest with Faded Book, Chapter 19.

sections.heading: Preparations in Eltisweiss
steps: Visit the Blacksmith to upgrade weapons.
Stop by the general store to restock healing items and grab a couple Runeshards of Return (warp to dungeon entrances).
Check the Armor Shop for solid defensive upgrades.
The Rune Shop is available but you likely can't equip much yet depending on levels — hold off for now.
Easy recruits to hit Ymir's quota: Mellore, Iugo, and Yusuke.
Once your party is set, return to the Heroes' Den. Ymir will approach with your first official job.

walkthrough.title: Searching the Tunnels — Abandoned Mine
walkthrough.summary_id: Para bandit meresahkan Altverden dan jejaknya mengarah ke Tambang Terbengkalai. Susuri terowongan gelapnya dan bereskan para penjahat itu.
walkthrough.summary_en: Bandits are troubling Altverden and their trail leads to the Abandoned Mine. Delve through its dark tunnels and deal with the criminals.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: After Ymir assigns the job, leave Eltisweiss through the south. A cutscene puts you on the field — head west to Altverden (blue marker).
In Altverden's northwest corner, a cutscene recruits the healer Francesca.
Enter the building with the blue dot and talk to the old man in the theater to advance the story. You'll learn the bandits may hide in an abandoned mine to the west.
Stock up, then head west out of town.

sections.heading: The Abandoned Mine
steps: At the mine entrance, check the chest to your right for 900 baqua. A cutscene opens the way — save, then proceed.
You'll find a minecart you can grab and push (same button to release). Nudge the first carts forward just enough to squeeze past, but not so far you can't get through narrow gaps.
In the north section, open a chest for a Topaz Ring (+5 defense — good on Garr or a frail character like Lian).
Head right to another minecart. Pull it back slightly, then go southwest to a dead end with a 900 baqua chest.
Loop back to where you pulled the cart and enter the passage it was blocking for a chest with a Rune of Earth.

sections.heading: The Blocked Path
steps: Heading toward the blue objective marker, a cracked boulder blocks the path. Remember the minecart with a boulder in it — pull it back (rolling it to the bridge works), then charge forward to smash through.
Cross the bridge and go far right for a chest with the Heavy Helm. Then enter the inner opening to the structure's second story.
Cross the left bridge and climb the spire. A chest immediately left has 6 Antivenom Herbs. Circle the round path for another chest with 900 baqua.
Cross the rear bridge to another spire. Circle it to find a blue chest south with the Rune of Feint Thrust.
Cross to the third spire and go through the gate to descend. Circle it, and just before becoming visible again, head north onto the rear bridge for a blue chest with a Rune of Power.

Return to the main column, go left, and talk to the man with the blue bandana — merchant Hiro. He sells Healing Incense (60 HP to all allies, pricey but lifesaving). Grab the 900 baqua chest next to him.
Go back across the spire, descend, head right along the tracks to the next room. Grab the save point on your left.

sections.heading: The Bridge
steps: Save, then push the two minecarts on the bridge and press the button. The right bridge lowers and the left rises — cross it.
Collect the chest left of the tracks (6 Healing Herbs). Head left, then south at the fork for 2 Revival Medicines.
Continue west, grabbing a 900 baqua chest on the way. When a path opens north, push the minecart through to reach a small room with a blue chest: Rune of Resistance.
Return to the main path, save, then grab the 6 Healing Herbs chest southeast. Head north (the left path is blocked, go right).
The path is mostly linear — check the corner at the marked spot for a 900 baqua chest.
For the elusive red chest above: enter the gate, go right through another gate for a blue chest with 2 Magic Drops (45 MP each). Go deeper for a standard 900 baqua chest.

Re-enter the gate, take the far-left bridge to its end for a small chest, then go through the gate behind you and left to reach the red chest: the Growth Badge (moderately boosts EXP). Equip it on someone with a free slot.
Head back down, go all the way right for a blue chest with Anti-Poison Beads (slight poison resistance).
Go left, take the second north path. The far-north gate has a chest with 2 Revival Medicines. Further left is a blue chest with a Rune of Defense.
At the path's far right end, a blue chest holds a Rune of Skill. Head south for a chest with a Fluffy Shield.
Take the marked exit for a small room with the Rune of Water, then head to the main objective.
Entering the next room, immediately go south for 6 Quality Healing Herbs (100 HP each — a big upgrade). Head north; a cutscene warns a wall is about to collapse.

sections.heading: Light at the End of the Tunnel
steps: Ram the minecart into the right wall to load a boulder into it, then grab it from the other side and slam it into the left boulder to open the path.

At the bridge mechanism: ignore the near cart, go to the far north one (empty), charge ahead to load a boulder, pull it back to the weight mechanism, then push the other cart on. Hit the button to raise the left bridge. Grab the 900 baqua chest left first, then cross.
Save, then head forward. Go left for a blue chest with a Rune of Speed, then right.
Go north to a dead-end chest with 2 Magic Drops. Head back south, then left down the narrow path, all the way left, then north for a blue chest with Dash Boots (speed accessory — good on slow Garr).
Continue right along the northern path to a blue chest with a Rune of Fire. Keep right, save at the save point — boss ahead, so prepare.

sections.heading: Boss Battle: Yuthus, Kogen, and Zabi
steps: Focus the shieldbearer Yuthus first — he keeps protecting his allies, so removing him early simplifies the fight.
After Yuthus falls, Kogen deploys a crane contraption that drops a boulder on your team. Use the gimmick 'Change Rockfall Location' on your turn to redirect it onto Kogen and Zabi.
You only sometimes get the chance to redirect. When you do, make sure the character moving it acts AFTER Kogen, so the target shifts after he loads it.
Next focus Kogen — he hits much harder than Zabi. Then finish Zabi; keep reasonably healed but there's no big group attack to fear.
A cutscene reveals the bandits were stealing to feed their hungry town. After another cutscene, you return to the Heroes' Den for the next mission.

walkthrough.title: Homecoming — Kyshiri
walkthrough.summary_id: Nowa pulang ke Desa Kyshiri, kampung halamannya. Kunjungan penuh nostalgia ini tidak bertahan lama sebelum masalah baru muncul.
walkthrough.summary_en: Nowa returns to Kyshiri Village, his hometown. The nostalgic visit does not last long before new trouble appears.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: Pick up this mission at the Heroes' Den. Good time to prepare: shop for healing items, upgrade weapons at the blacksmith, equip new runes at the rune shop, store excess items (especially runes) at the Den's right counter, and recruit — Gigina is newly available.
When ready, talk to Ymir. You're heading to Nowa's hometown Kyshiri, which has bandit trouble like Altverden.
Form your party and head out. On the world map, go to the blue circle: Mountain Path Homeward. Save immediately, then continue.
Two chests on the path: detour north for a blue chest with a Rune of Wind, and after crossing the bridge grab a chest with 900 baqua.
At the path's end you enter Kyshiri Village Area.

sections.heading: Investigating Kyshiri Village
steps: Head to the northwest marker to reach Nowa's hometown. Talk to the merchant outside the inn for decent armor upgrades if you can afford them.
Visit the northernmost house for Faded Book, Chapter 2.
Then head to the objective to reunite Nowa with his family. Enter Nowa's house, check Leene's room, and open the red chest for the Red Riding Hood Script before leaving.
Head out to investigate the commotion in the village.

sections.heading: Boss Battle: Hurstwine
steps: This is a scripted fight you can't truly win. Focus on Hurstwine's lackeys — the battle ends once they're down.
Flee the village afterward. Three more bandit groups will chase you; they go down easily.
After the cutscenes, report back to Eltisweiss at once.

walkthrough.title: Infiltrate the Empire — Werne Village
walkthrough.summary_id: Misi penyusupan ke kamp Kekaisaran dimulai dari Desa Werne. Bergeraklah dalam diam dan kumpulkan informasi tanpa ketahuan musuh.
walkthrough.summary_en: A stealth mission into an Imperial camp begins at Werne Village. Move silently and gather intel without being spotted by the enemy.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: On the way back to Eltisweiss through Mountain Path Homeward, Mio intercepts you and escorts you to town.
After the conversation, Sabine joins your forces. Your task: scout the Imperial occupation at Werne Village.
Prepare, then head northwest to the marked village. No chests here — it's a stealth operation.

sections.heading: Sneaking Through Werne Village
steps: Stay out of the guards' light — you don't need to move slowly, just avoid being seen. Wait for the left guard to turn, then circle around him to the first objective.
Head north. Nowa auto-hides in the first barrel as you approach. When clear, go northwest and hide in the next barrel until you can push further north.
For the last barrel: wait until the circled guard faces right, hide, then when he faces left, hop out and sprint to the marked tent.
After the dialogue, take a couple steps right instead of going around the left guards. Then circle the left guards, hugging the right tent to avoid the northern guard's sight.
After more dialogue, head right toward the large dragon-like machine.

sections.heading: Escape From Werne Village
steps: After the strange cutscene with the engineer Pohl, the alarm sounds. Fight through bands of Imperial Soldiers on your way out — none are particularly strong.
Once clear, return to Eltisweiss and report to the Heroes' Den to finish the mission.

walkthrough.title: The Eltisweiss Front — Eltisweiss
walkthrough.summary_id: Kekaisaran bersiap melancarkan serangan besar ke Eltisweiss. Siapkan pertahanan kota dan hadapi gelombang pasukan musuh yang datang.
walkthrough.summary_en: The Empire is preparing a major assault on Eltisweiss. Ready the town's defenses and face the incoming waves of enemy troops.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: This chapter introduces the War battle system and features a unique boss fight.

sections.heading: Preparations in Eltisweiss
steps: After the preparation montage, you control Nowa in his quarters. Go down to the Den's main room, speak with the crew at the table, then talk to Ymir when ready — tough battles await.
Checklist: form your party at the left desk, upgrade weapons as high as possible at the Blacksmith (aim for Lv. 4), stock Healing Herbs and Revival Medicines, and tune up runes at the Rune Shop.
When ready, talk to the Watch members at the table to begin the war effort.

sections.heading: The Battle for Eltisweiss: War
steps: War battles have you command separate legions. Here: Nowa, Sabine, and Ymir each lead one.
Push Nowa's and Ymir's legions forward to meet enemies coming from the sides.
Nowa and Ymir have powerful Legion Commands that boost their legion and adjacent ones — use them on turns you attack.
Keep Sabine's legion in place. Chapell's legion charges straight at it and you'll crush him easily.
Defeat Chapell to win. A dialogue choice follows, but it only affects how dorky Nowa sounds.

Then Dux Aldric arrives with overwhelming numbers and you retreat through the streets. After talks with Perrielle and the nobles, form your party — Nowa, Garr, Lian, and Mio are required, plus two of your best (or set extras as Attendants).
Head east out of Eltisweiss toward the Castle Ruins. Imperial Soldiers stop you twice, then you face Seign and Hildi's unit on the bridge.

sections.heading: Boss Fight: Seign
steps: Your first one-on-one duel. Alternate Attack and Counter to build the tension meter, then unleash Break at max.
After that, Nowa loses to Seign regardless — just Attack until your HP runs out.
Following the noble scenes in Eltisweiss, you're taken to the Castle Ruins. Talk to Lian for a final cutscene, ending the chapter on a hopeful note.

walkthrough.title: Hoist the Alliance Banner — Castle HQ
walkthrough.summary_id: Usai pertempuran, saatnya membangun kembali dari Kastil HQ. Aliansi resmi terbentuk dan pembangunan markas dimulai dari reruntuhannya.
walkthrough.summary_en: After the battle, it is time to rebuild from Castle HQ. The Alliance officially forms and headquarters construction begins from its ruins.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: Leave Nowa's room and chat with Lian, then follow the mini-map's upper-right hallway to the Great Hall to meet the Resistance.
You'll name your new headquarters — choose between Excalibur, Tetsudo Town, or Tibisee Castle. It's purely cosmetic.
Leave the hall and go downstairs to see the Drafting Studio (your future town-building hub — nothing to build yet). Explore the other facilities to the left.

Key services: Ymir handles party formation (like at the Heroes' Den), Sumire runs the warehouse for storing/selling items, Caine operates the Resource Depot where you sell foraged supplies for town funds. The new Inn is southeast outside the castle's south exit.

sections.heading: New Recruits
steps: There's no objective marker now — progress by recruiting allies to grow the town and the Alliance. Some easy pickups:
Nowa's Aunt Martha (from Homecoming) is in town just east of the Inn.
Southeast at Bounty Hill, start a side quest to recruit Wyler and Marin.
Southwest in the Dappled Forest, find Kerrin just right of the entrance — bring 20 Lumber.
Once they're in, a cutscene shows the town coming together (Zabi comments on it), then the perspective shifts elsewhere.

walkthrough.title: In an Unknown Village — Yarnaan
walkthrough.summary_id: Sudut pandang beralih ke Marisa yang tersadar di Yarnaan yang misterius. Jelajahi desa asing ini dan cari tahu apa yang sebenarnya terjadi.
walkthrough.summary_en: The perspective shifts to Marisa, who wakes up in the mysterious Yarnaan. Explore the unfamiliar village and find out what is really going on.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: You now control Marisa, the new hero, after completing the previous chapter. Chat with locals to get your bearings — there are no chests in this village.
When ready, head north to the bowl-shaped structure and take it to 3F, then go through the northern doors.
More story reveals the villagers' connection to Nowa's sister Leene. Then the perspective snaps back to Nowa and Garr at your Castle HQ.
As Nowa, head outside to investigate a disturbance. Sumire introduces a Treefolk wanderer: Kallathor, who wants to return home after traveling the world.
Form your party and get ready to move out.

walkthrough.title: The Village of the Treefolk — Greatwood
walkthrough.summary_id: Bertemu kaum Treefolk di Greatwood dan pelajari budaya mereka. Diplomasi di sini sangat penting untuk memperluas Aliansi.
walkthrough.summary_en: Meet the Treefolk in the Greatwood and learn about their culture. Diplomacy here is vital for expanding the Alliance.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: Leave town for the far-south clearing marked as your objective to enter the Greatwood. Kallathor clears a path for you.

sections.heading: The East Greatwood
steps: Take the left path to its end for a chest with 1500 baqua.
Then take the rightmost north path — the dead end holds Scale Armor, great on bulky characters like Garr.
Further north, watch for a right-hand path to a chest with 3 Runeshards of Fire (one-use magic items usable even by non-mages).

Head north across the rocks, then go south and loop to the river island. Talk to Gieran to learn about the Rune of Conservation — you'll need to deliver one to recruit him. Loot the nearby blue chest for Confusion Beads.
Back on the main path, take the left turn for a chest with 6 Healing Herbs, then pass through the gate into the Greatwood depths. Save, then follow the tangled branches.

Optional full clear: go north then right, circle right for a medicine chest. Head left, use the strange plant to reach a blue chest with a crit-boosting Necklace. Take the plant back, return to the starting circle, go left, use the plant, and grab the Hard Scale Band (strong early headgear).
Otherwise head right, use the plant to ascend, save, and prepare for the boss.

sections.heading: Boss Battle: Ancient Seed
steps: Physical attacks trigger a counterattack — use magic instead to avoid retaliation.
Bring a mage with a Rune of Water for Recovery Wave to keep the team healthy.
Afterward, return to the strange creature that brought you up, backtrack to Gieran, and say 'You have a place with us' to recruit him.

Head back to the boss arena and continue north to reach Treefolk Village. After heavy story dialogue (including a crossover with Marisa), your next mission is finding the local Runebarrows: the Proving Ground.

walkthrough.title: The Proving Grounds — Proving Grounds
walkthrough.summary_id: Nowa dan Marisa menyelidiki Runebarrows yang baru ditemukan sambil mencari Leene, kakak Nowa yang hilang. Ujian berat sudah menanti di dalam.
walkthrough.summary_en: Nowa and Marisa investigate a newly discovered Runebarrows while searching for Leene, Nowa's missing sister. Heavy trials already await inside.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: One of the more involved dungeons — rotating corridors, many chests, and back-to-back bosses.

sections.heading: Path to the Proving Grounds
steps: Head northwest of the village to the Road to the Proving Grounds. Three chests here:
Go right — a chest hidden in retractable fauna holds 1500 baqua.
Cross to the far right side, then head left for another 1500 baqua chest.
Go left and slightly forward for a blue chest with 2 Magic Drops. Then advance to the main objective.

sections.heading: The Puzzles
steps: Gear barricades move aside as you approach. At the path's end, go right for a 1500 baqua chest, then interact with the large circular pad before the gate.
Inside: rotating corridors. Set the front tumbler with the red light on the bottom, then follow the blue line. In the next room take the south line to a propeller platform and ride up.

Upper level, blue chest puzzle: step on the left platform to shift a gear blocking the right path. Take the right path, step on the motion sensor to move the farthest gear. Step on the left sensor, back up, step again to clear the path.
Reward: blue chest with a Ruby Brooch (+15 strength accessory). The gears should now align — take the middle path and follow the blue line to the end, then go left and interact with the gears.
After dialogue, take the right propeller platform back down. Grab the southern blue chest (2 Magic Drops), then interact with the blue circle to open the gate.

Back at the start, use the terminal twice and follow the blue line to the staircase. This time go north, take the right exit, continue straight to another staircase. Head in, go south to a propeller platform down to the lower level.

For the left blue chest (Tanzanite Brooch, magic boost): step on the left motion sensor, step back on it, walk back to start. Left sensor moves the two near gears, right sensor the two far ones, middle sensor all four.
Reach the end, activate the side gears, ride the propeller platform up. Collect 6 Quality Healing Herbs nearby, then use the glowing circle to open the gate.

sections.heading: The Chests
steps: Back at the start, rotate the corridor to match the reference (propeller platform at the bottom). Take the right gate, reverse your earlier gear path, exit the first door to the staircase, ride up for a blue chest: Rune of Sidewinder.
Take the left gate and backtrack. Descend, follow the blue line to the upper path, cross the middle, ride another propeller platform up for a blue chest: Rune of Quick Slash.

Set the terminal to the teal-light configuration. Take the right path and backtrack, then the further north exit, follow the blue line north to a propeller platform down to a blue chest: Palenight Mail (strong armor).
Ride back up, follow the blue line south. Loot the rightmost stairs chest (Topaz Brooch, defense), then ride down for a Rune of Fire Enchantment (grants magic-sword ability).

For the main path: set the terminal to the purple-light configuration. Follow the line north as far as possible, go left up the stairs, loot 1500 baqua, ride the propeller platform, follow the blue line to another platform, and activate the rune.
Rearrange the corridor again. Take the first left staircase, then the north exit. Follow the blue line north to its end, then head right.
Ride the propeller platform down, then another. You'll hit a switch in a small passage — Kallathor saves the day and activates it, opening the corridor's end door.
Return to the terminal, arrange a straight path to the gate, save, and go through to face the boss.

sections.heading: Boss Fight: Astraea the Judge and Slaosha the Enforcer
steps: No gimmick here — pure stats and strategy. Target Slaosha first; Astraea's full-party attacks get brutal as her HP drops.
Bring at least one Rune of Water user: Water Veil boosts magic defense and Recovery Wave heals — both are key to surviving Astraea's second phase.
After they fall, keep walking north into the depths. Dialogue reunites the party with an old friend and new enemies. Heal up, then walk forward for the next fight.

sections.heading: Boss Fight: Hurstwine and Narungarde
steps: Unlike Homecoming, you can beat Hurstwine this time. No gimmick — focus one enemy at a time.
Prioritize Hurstwine; his sleep status is annoying. Have a tanky character feed healing items since the pair hits hard.
After the cutscenes, return to Treefolk Village to complete the quest.

walkthrough.title: Euchrisse, the Land of Water — South Greatwood
walkthrough.summary_id: Perjalanan ke Euchrisse, negeri air, untuk bertemu kembali dengan Lady Perrielle. Negosiasi aliansi ternyata tidak semudah yang dibayangkan.
walkthrough.summary_en: Travel to Euchrisse, the land of water, to reunite with Lady Perrielle. Alliance negotiations turn out to be trickier than expected.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: Before departing, handle business at HQ: shop, upgrade at the Drafting Table, and store unneeded items on the castle's first floor.
Return to Treefolk Village via the same route as before. Use any facilities your HQ lacks (like the Rune Shop) before proceeding.
When ready, take the left path from your mini-map objective into Greatwood South.

sections.heading: Greatwood South
steps: Save on arrival. Descend to the lower area, loop around to a blue chest: Malachite Brooch (+100 Max HP — great on frail characters).
Head back, use the strange plant, go northeast and loop to another plant and a blue chest: Turquoise Brooch (+Max MP). Use the plant again to descend.
Go north, reuse the first plant, then head south to continue. You'll reach another Greatwood section bordering Euchrisse.

Before the northern objective: go left, use the plant, find a blue chest with an Armband (extends damage range — lets short-range heroes sit in back or hit back-row enemies; costs an equipment slot, so choose wisely). Follow the side path to another plant.
After being ejected, go right for a blue chest: Pearl Brooch (+dexterity). Head back north, use another plant to return to the main path.
Cross the branch bridge north. Watch right for 2 Magic Drops and left for 1800 baqua. At the path's end you reach Euchrisse — head east following the minimap arrow to Hishahn.

sections.heading: Meeting Perrielle in Hishahn
steps: Explore the city first — the blacksmith is worth a visit for weapon upgrades.
When ready, go to the northern Inn to reunite with Perrielle and Janquis. Perrielle joins your party; head with her to the far-north palace.
You'll witness the Alliance-royalty meeting about the war plan. Afterward, your mission: convince Euchrisse's king to join against the Empire.

walkthrough.title: Reveal Harlan's Schemes! — Hishahn Old Town
walkthrough.summary_id: Selidiki Harlan, penasihat Raja Euma, di Kota Tua Hishahn yang tergenang banjir. Bongkar rencananya sebelum semuanya terlambat.
walkthrough.summary_en: Investigate Harlan, King Euma's advisor, in the flooded Hishahn Old Town. Expose his schemes before it is all too late.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: Covers the Euchrisse palace intrigue, recruiting Carrie (required!), and the flooded Old Town dungeon with the Pagurian boss.

sections.heading: The Despondent King
steps: Leave your current spot, cross the bridge in the palace's left section (marked on the mini-map), and talk to Yulin, King Euma's handmaid, waiting there. She'll share some background, then head back to Perrielle — she rejoins your party and you're sent to wander Hishahn.
Good time to restock. Otherwise head to the southwest objective to meet Carrie for the first time.
You MUST fully recruit Carrie to progress the next mission — use the recruitment guide to track her down.

Recruiting Carrie unlocks fast travel: open the map menu, pick visited locations, and warp. Use it to revisit shops (like the Rune Shop), recruit missed heroes, or check HQ for crafting progress — you can now gather Mystic Lumber in Greatwood South.

sections.heading: Reveal Harlan's Schemes
steps: Make sure Carrie is IN your party — you can't progress without her, even though the party menu doesn't require her.
Leave Hishahn for the southernmost point of Euchrisse: flooded Hishahn Old Town. Interact with the barrel left of you and push it into the water, then walk into it to hop across.
Follow the rooftop path left. At the first fork, go left for a blue chest with 2 Magic Drops, then head back right.
At a dead end you'll be told you need outside help — that's your cue to go recruit Carrie if you haven't. With her in the party, she'll warp you across the water.
On the other side, save and take the right wooden path. Grab the 2300 baqua chest on the path, then head left to another barrel — push it left and hop across as before.
Go south, follow the path to a branch, keep north to a dead end, then go left and push a barrel into the water.
Backtrack to the other left-leading path and push that barrel in too. With both in the water, step onto the debris and hop across the barrels.
Climb the wooden structures, loot the right-side chest for 6 Quality Healing Herbs, then push another barrel off a roof ahead.
Cross back over the water, push the left barrel, hop across, and go left. Save when you see the save point, then advance to the boss.

sections.heading: Boss Fight: Pagurian
steps: The giant crab fights alongside its two children. Knock down the Young Pagurians to stagger the main one and nullify its attacks for the current and next turn.
Focus both children-attacks on ONE child at a time. Hit them with characters who act before the big Pagurian to maximize the stagger window.
When it's flipped on its back and weakened, unload your strongest Rune-Lens techniques.
Victory earns the Rune of Currents (Level III–V water magic).
Heal, save, then head right from the arena. Take the south path for the Earning Bangle (boosts baqua from battles).
Follow the main path to a blue chest with a Rune of Water Enchantment, then go right, hop a barrel, and climb toward the finale.
You'll overhear Harlan conspiring with the sinister Narungarde — confirming Melridge's suspicions.
Enter the manor: check the back-left shimmer for a gag item (Harlan's Underwear), then examine the desk to find the Dux Aldric–Harlan contract.

Present the proof at Melridge's residence. After cutscenes, head to the palace to execute the scholar's plan, then find Euma in the palace's southeast corner (marked). One more chat and the mission completes.

walkthrough.title: The Hishahn Front — Hishahn
walkthrough.summary_id: Kekaisaran menyerbu Hishahn dan kota ini harus dipertahankan. Pimpin pasukan Aliansi dalam pertempuran yang sengit.
walkthrough.summary_en: The Empire invades Hishahn and the city must be defended. Lead the Alliance forces in a fierce battle.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: King Euma's decision, preparations, and two large War battles for Hishahn.

sections.heading: What's the Right Choice?
steps: When Nowa wakes, head to the palace throne room to press Euma — the Empire's march decides for him.
Afterward, meet Sabine and Janquis at the inn to discuss preparations. You can tell them to wait, but free travel remains available, so prepare at your pace:
Explore Euchrisse's other towns for missed items and recruits. Fast-travel to old towns for new content. Tune your preferred party's equipment and runes.
When ready, head to Hishahn's palace to begin.

sections.heading: The Ambush in Hishahn
steps: Grid-based War battle. You start with only Kassius's Euchrisse legion. First move one square toward the enemy legion; next, use the 'Scheme' Legion Command, then advance again.

Your first combat triggers Nowa and the Alliance to charge in behind. Then: move Nowa, Kassius, and Barnard's legions onto Goldwyn's square. Send Ymir at Seign. Use Barnard's charge Command to join allied squares, then hit Goldwyn with Nowa, Kassius, and Barnard together while Ymir keeps pressuring Seign.
Goldwyn withdraws with the Imperials — the Alliance's first victory. After Empire-side cutscenes, gather at the palace for round two.

sections.heading: The Battle for Hishahn
steps: Turn 1: move everything straight ahead. Turn 2: use Nowa's Cross Boost Legion Command, then charge all legions forward.
A cutscene throws chaos in — a new legion joins, another stands down, and General Chapell becomes the target.
Send Nowa and Ymir at the upper enemies; Kassius and Barnard take the lower ones. Repeat once more next turn.
With the enemy legions broken, the Alliance wins again. After Alliance/Empire cutscenes, you return to Castle HQ for the next mission.

walkthrough.title: New Forces — Shandar Ridge
walkthrough.summary_id: Nowa dan Barnard menyeberangi gurun menuju Shandar Ridge untuk merekrut sekutu baru. Perjalanan gurunnya penuh bahaya.
walkthrough.summary_en: Nowa and Barnard cross the desert toward Shandar Ridge to recruit new allies. The desert journey is full of danger.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: Nowa's split-story mission through Shandar Ridge to the Shi'arc lands. Also sets up Seign's parallel mission.

sections.heading: The Assassinated Emperor
steps: In the Great Hall, new allies join: Barnard and Melridge from Euchrisse, plus Seign and Hildi from the Empire (your Runebarrows companions).

Next destination: Impershi'arc, home of the Shi'arcs. The story splits — Nowa leads one team, Seign the other. You have two missions: New Forces (Nowa) and To the Safehouse (Seign). This section covers Nowa's.

sections.heading: New Forces — Shandar Ridge
steps: Fast-travel to Hishahn Old Town (or Daphan Village if visited), then head far east to the desert path: Shandar Ridge. The guard now lets you pass.
Go right, then south when possible, for a chest behind a rocky outcrop: Rune of Mighty Power.
Back north, further right, then south again for a chest with the Knight's Guard (tanky headgear).
Continue north; grab a chest with 6 Quality Healing Herbs on the way.
On the linear stretch, take the south branch for a blue chest: Rune of High Magic.
Back north along the path; climbing the hill, find an Anti-Poison Corsage chest.
Push to the save point. Save and heal — boss ahead. Equip anti-poison gear and bring Antivenom Herbs.

sections.heading: Boss Battle: Surkkamui
steps: Surkkamui leans heavily on poison — anti-poison accessories and Antivenom Herbs help a lot.
If a character resists the damage well, it can be worth just enduring the poison rather than spending their turn curing it.
Most of its attacks are magical — boost magic defense with runes.
Afterward, follow the path; a cutscene leads to a blue chest with Magic Holy Water (90 MP to one ally).

sections.heading: Arrival at Dabavin
steps: At the path's end you reach the Eastern Desert overworld. Cross to the far side for Dabavin.
Follow the objective marker to learn about Shi'arc transport. Keep left after the ship cutscene; tell Scarlet you're ready to sail to the capital.
You arrive in Impershi'arc — ready for the next mission.

walkthrough.title: Shi'arcs of a Scale — Impershi'arc
walkthrough.summary_id: Ikuti kontes di Impershi'arc untuk memenangkan kesetiaan kaum Shi'arc. Menangkan dengan strategi cerdik, bukan sekadar kekuatan.
walkthrough.summary_en: Enter a contest at Impershi'arc to win the loyalty of the Shi'arcs. Win with clever strategy, not just brute strength.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: Nowa's Shi'arc racing chapter in Impershi'arc — learn the shi'arcraft, win the race, and recruit the shark-folk.

sections.heading: Across the Desert
steps: Welcome to Impershi'arc. Optional prep: recruit newly available allies, visit the Rune Shop for your new chest runes, and shop for healing items/armor.
Otherwise follow the map marker to meet Shoalmeister Skyd. He wants proof of Nowa's worth — say 'Of course I will!' to enter the shi'arcraft race.

sections.heading: Learning the Shi'arcraft
steps: Join the crowd and talk to the leader by the right-side inn: Yuferius, your coach. Answer 'You bet I'm ready, Coach!' to start (or explore and return later).
The first race is a no-stakes practice — use it to learn the controls:
Hold forward before the start for a boost. Dash whenever the gauge hits 3 (bottom-right) — extra charges beyond that are wasted. Sail through the gates; they're optional but improve your time.

sections.heading: Shi'arcs of a Scale
steps: After training, Yuferius tells you to rest at the inn — you'll auto-advance to race day.
Barnard notes second place is enough to impress them (that's the minimum to progress). Beat the target time to guarantee second; finish under a minute to win outright.
Save before the race if you're chasing first — no retries after placing second.
Second place: Honor Scale Armor. First place: the stronger Golden Scale Armor plus extra Shi'arc praise. The better armor is worth the effort.
With the Shi'arcs allied, return to Castle HQ. Talk to Yuferius in the Great Hall; Barnard confirms Nowa's work is done for now — the story shifts to Seign's party in Ardinale City.

walkthrough.title: The Rune-Lens Research Laboratory
walkthrough.summary_id: Pihak Seign menyelidiki laboratorium penelitian Rune-Lens. Misi ini menampilkan sudut pandang Kekaisaran sekaligus rahasia di balik lens.
walkthrough.summary_en: Seign's side investigates a Rune-Lens research laboratory. This mission shows the Imperial perspective along with the secrets behind the lens.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: Seign's main mission after the split: infiltrate the Rune-Lens Research Laboratory, survive a boss gauntlet, and escape.

sections.heading: To the Safehouse
steps: Seign's story opens in Ardinale City, mourning the emperor. Head to the lower southwest level — go toward the exit, down the right-hand stairs, loop left along the bottom to find Valentin.
Check behind the general store to meet the other Imperial dissidents. Head east across town to see the rune-tank (familiar from War battles).
Before moving on, hit the Rune Shop and Smithy — the Rune of Dark is excellent on a magic-focused character like Hildi.

sections.heading: The Rune-Lens Research Laboratory
steps: Entering the lab, take the left path first for a red chest: Anti-Confuse Scarf.
Head right, watching north for a chest with the Red Key. Go as far right and north as possible to a red-locked door; inside is a chest with the Blue Key.
Back south, take the left path to a door your new key opens. Keep left into a side room for a blue chest: Patchwork Armor (very strong).
Return to the center corridor and head north. Save at the save point, but the north door won't open yet.
Go back to the right path and open it for a new restaurant recipe.
Return to the left path toward the objective. The left room has a tough (non-boss) fight — focus one enemy at a time.

Keep left, watch north for a chest with another Blue Key. Go left, then south at the split. Head right for a recipe in a blue chest, then back to the main path south. Use the Blue Key on the door for another Red Key.
Back north, take the left path, open the red door, and loot a blue chest: Crankshaft. Return to the center corridor and use it on the right side of the end gate to open it.
Save and go through for cutscenes and the area boss.

sections.heading: Boss Fight: Dux Aldric
steps: Like the Seign duel in The Eltisweiss Front, this is a scripted one-on-one about building Tension. Keep choosing Counter until you can use Break — the battle ends on rails.
After story beats, the team regroups outside. Head right to the save point, heal, and talk to Pohl when ready — one more trial awaits.
The rebels flee in the Rune-Tank but a monster blocks the escape.

sections.heading: Boss Fight: Modified Specimens
steps: Modified Specimen W_1155: bring at least one Rune of Water user — Recovery Wave after its Howl is invaluable. It otherwise targets one ally at a time.

Heavy Modified Specimen B_1929: it opens in a counterstance — use the free first turn to heal up from the last fight, then go all-out, healing when things get dicey. Then Narungarde sics another beast on you.

Synthetic Specimen: no breather this time, but its opening attacks are mild single-target hits. Heal as needed, then hit back with your strongest Rune-Lens techniques. Before its Volcanic Eruption, raise magic defense with Water Veil — survive that and you've basically won.

Chimera: you get a gimmick to fire the Rune-Tank cannon (1000 damage, but disables it for two turns). Prioritize survival and fire the cannon whenever available — especially to interrupt its Build Up. Use a character faster than the Chimera (Valentin works) for the interrupt; if you can't, Water Veil up to soak the charged hit.
After the escape, more cutscenes return you to Ardinale City. Then you regain Nowa and reunite both teams in the Castle HQ Great Hall.

walkthrough.title: To Norristar, the Western Nation — Eldroad
walkthrough.summary_id: Cari sekutu di bangsa barat Norristar melalui Eldroad. Diplomasi antar bangsa akan menentukan masa depan Aliansi.
walkthrough.summary_en: Seek allies in the western nation of Norristar via Eldroad. Diplomacy between nations will decide the Alliance's future.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: The teams reunite, Marisa joins the core trio, and you travel the Eldroad to Yarnaan — with an Elder Dragon ambush on the way.

sections.heading: Reunion
steps: After back-to-back cutscenes, Nowa wakes with no objective marker. Leave Castle HQ and come back to trigger Ymir's summons to the Great Hall.

There you assemble the full protagonist trio with Marisa (your Proving Grounds lead). Before departing, prep at HQ (or fast-travel elsewhere): upgrade weapons at the Smithy, tune runes at the Rune Shop, and recruit anyone you want.
Leave town for the northwest objective: the Eldroad.

sections.heading: The Eldroad
steps: The path is fairly linear. Keep eyes south early for a red chest: Anti-Petrify Scarf.

Further along, an abandoned rocky structure north holds a blue chest — but its guardian requires Code L in your party. She's tough; come back later if needed. Beating her recruits her and yields a recipe.
Back on the main path you'll hit a save point. Save, heal, and advance for the area boss.

sections.heading: Boss Battle: Elder Dragon
steps: One of the toughest fights so far. Nearly all its attacks are magical — keep Water Veil up for magic defense.
Many attacks hit the whole party, so keep group healing ready (items or spells). Carry Revival Medicine — its heavy hits can flatten frail members.
After the win, heal and continue. Head north at the opening, but first follow the current path to its end for a blue chest: Bloodstained Helmet.

Then go north through the stone structure to the upper path and left. At the fork, take the right path to its end for Faded Book, Chapter 15, then double back to finish the Eldroad — it ends at Marisa's home, Yarnaan.

sections.heading: Defending Yarnaan
steps: No rest — head to the town's south to defend against Revenants. After the cutscene you fight four Corpse Knights: durable but single-target attackers, so out-heal and outlast them.
Afterward, Nowa is summoned to the Yarnaan Grandwarden, closing this leg.

walkthrough.title: In the Land of Snow — Ice Cave
walkthrough.summary_id: Selamatkan anak-anak yang tersesat lalu ikuti jejak mereka masuk ke Gua Es. Dinginnya gua menyimpan monster-monster berbahaya.
walkthrough.summary_en: Rescue the lost children, then follow their trail into the Ice Cave. The freezing cave hides dangerous monsters.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: Travel to Norristar, explore Athrabalt, and delve the Ice Cave's slippery slides to rescue Skriss Village's children — then face Fenrir.

sections.heading: Meeting the Grandwarden
steps: Take Yarnaan's central elevator to 3F and enter the north door. You'll gain party members, then prepare for the real journey to Norristar.

sections.heading: The City of Athrabalt
steps: Rest at the inn, then leave through Yarnaan's west exit and head slightly southwest on the world map to Athrabalt, Norristar's capital.
City checklist: Smithy (weapons now up to Lv. 10), Armor Shop, Rune Shop, and the recruitment guide for missed heroes.
When ready, visit the northern palace. After the dialogue, the Alliance's mission is saving Skriss Village's children. Leave the city for the northwest-marked village.
In Skriss Village, rest and shop as needed, then head north to the Ice Cave.

sections.heading: Navigating the Ice Cave
steps: Head north to a save point and the first lost child. Icy winds freeze you — mash left/right to break free, as Nowa demonstrates.
Go left past the dialogue, down the northern stairs to a seemingly impassable ledge. Rudy's trick: freeze yourself, then slide down the hill.
Your first slide overshoots to the cave bottom — loot the left chest (Rune of Quick Slash), then slide again.
Next section: head south, and before the wind wall grab the blue chest (Ancient Shield). Then run back through the blowing wind to return to the start.
Ride the next wind current, mash free at the following section, slide down the northern ramp, and climb without freezing. At the top you rescue a child and get an Anti-Paralysis Scarf.
Slide down the southern ramp to topple the giant ice pillar into a makeshift bridge.
Cross it, save, and continue. Take the descending path and slide down to find Arlo, the second child — one left. Head back southwest to the cave top.
At the top, thaw in the third section for a blue chest: Rune of Currents (needed to recruit Code L if you haven't; otherwise a strong healer rune).

Slide back to the fallen pillar, cross, and this time take the southwest path at the far save point. Slide down; before the wind, go right for a chest with an Eyepatch (accuracy). Slide down and save.
Boss ahead — equip the Blue Symbol on frail characters, heal up, then head right.

sections.heading: Boss Fight: Fenrir
steps: Eiyuden's Fenrir is an icy three-headed beast. Use the battle gimmick to drop the giant icicle — but only a long-range character can trigger it.
Water Veil softens most of its attacks. In its final phase (eyes glow green) its attacks spike — save your strongest items for then and rely on healing spells before that.
Win to rescue all the children. After the village cutscene, Rudy joins. Return to Athrabalt — but trouble is brewing back in Yarnaan, your next destination.

walkthrough.title: A Secret Plan — Snowpeak Pass
walkthrough.summary_id: Aliansi menyusun rencana rahasia untuk memperlambat laju Kekaisaran di Snowpeak Pass. Eksekusi yang tepat menjadi kunci keberhasilan.
walkthrough.summary_en: The Alliance hatches a secret plan to slow the Imperial advance at Snowpeak Pass. Precise execution is the key to success.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: Defend Yarnaan from the Revenant army, then execute the three-team Snowpeak Pass operation — ending in a scripted clash with Heinrich.

sections.heading: The Coming Storm
steps: Fast travel is disabled for the return — warp to Eldroad and walk back to Yarnaan. Head to the village center, 3F, for the cutscene.

sections.heading: The Revenant Army Returns
steps: The revenants are Narungarde's plot with a new accomplice. Make sure your party is fit, then head to the village's east side on 1F.
Conserve items and magic — encounters come with little breathing room.
First: three Corpse Guards (not too dangerous). Next: two Guards plus two Corpse Witches — kill the Witches first; their Sacrificial Brand deals nasty damage-over-time.
Village center: three Corpse Witches (frail, quick kills), then four Witches plus a tough Guard — Witches first again.
You'll get a chance to fall back north and heal. Then: 2 Witches + 2 Guards (easy), followed by 3 Witches + 3 Guards — use group attacks to end it fast.
Exit past the Eldroad back to Athrabalt Palace to advance the story, then rest at the inn and set formations. Nowa, Seign, and Marisa are all required for the next mission.
Leave the city north for Snowpeak Pass. IMPORTANT: no hero can be on more than one of the three teams — spread your best units across them.

sections.heading: Seign's Team
steps: Seign leads Team Galdea (Seign, Pohl, Valentin, Hildi) plus two of your best. Head west.
At the fork, go right for an Anti-Blind Scarf chest. Keep west; at the next split go north for Wyvern Leather Shoes (evasion).
Continue right, then down the hill at the path's end for a Peridot Brooch chest. Return to the boulder at the hilltop — you've hit an impasse for now.

sections.heading: Marisa's Team
steps: Marisa heads east. Leene joins your team at the next section. First go left for a blue chest: Magical Holy Water.
Head north when possible and follow the path. After a dialogue, resume climbing — but first go right to the path's end for an Elemental Crystal (magic resistance).
Toward the objective, detour south just before it for a red chest: Opal Bangle (big luck boost). Then head north — Nil arms the runic charge and you're taken back to the mountain base.

sections.heading: Nowa's Team
steps: Assemble Nowa's team and head north. At the branch, briefly go left for a red chest: Anti-Sleep Scarf.
Back to the branch, north again, then right along the narrow branch for a red chest: Rune of the Sniper's Pinnacle (focus for units starting on high ground).
Return north to the objective — Nowa signals, Seign topples a boulder as a bridge.
Perspective shifts to Seign: follow the path to the peak, brief dialogue, and the charge is planted.
Back to Nowa: head right to the objective, save, and plant the charge when ready. Then descend toward the base.

sections.heading: Boss Fight: Heinrich
steps: Aldric's henchman Heinrich blocks the plan. Keep healed and don't stress damage — the party will note he's too strong no matter what.
The plan succeeds regardless. Return to Athrabalt to plan the next move.

walkthrough.title: The Athrabalt Front — Athrabalt
walkthrough.summary_id: Pertahankan Athrabalt, ibu kota Norristar, dari gempuran Kekaisaran. Ini menjadi salah satu pertempuran terbesar dalam perang.
walkthrough.summary_en: Defend Athrabalt, the capital of Norristar, from the Imperial onslaught. This becomes one of the biggest battles of the war.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: The grand Athrabalt War battle, then a three-team boss gauntlet against the Revenants at the city gates.

sections.heading: Preparations
steps: Back at the palace, cutscenes run back-to-back. You're told to rest at the inn — do it, and you'll wake on the big day.
Prep checklist: best runes at the Rune Shop, weapons to Lv. 12 at the Smithy, and the recruitment guide for any new members.
When ready, return to the palace and tell Melridge 'Let's go!' to begin.

sections.heading: The Battle for Athrabalt
steps: Turn 1: move all legions forward (you seem to outnumber them — until the Revenants join after turn 1).
Turn 2: use Marisa's Assault Legion Command, Wayve's Draw Out, charge the three left legions forward, hold the middle two, shift one right legion to the middle, then engage.
After this turn Chapell should be reeling — charge him once more for the win. Briefly, at least.
The Dux takes the field, but your goal is rendezvousing with the Kenani — stall on the back lines. Spend two turns not moving.
A cutscene exposes treachery; the Alliance retreats. Maxim warns 'they're here' — Revenants at the front gate. Like A Secret Plan, your forces split into three protagonist-led teams. Seign starts.
Bring at least one Rune of Water user — the coming fights are rough without it.

sections.heading: Boss Fight: Maiden-Revenant
steps: Rush straight for the west gate to meet the first boss. Get Water Veil up immediately for magic defense and keep it refreshed — her group attacks are deadly without it.
Use weaker characters to feed healing items. Then you take Nowa's team to the east gate.

sections.heading: Boss Fight: Samurai-Revenant
steps: The undead swordsman is physical and fast. Boost defense with Earth Enchantment runes or HQ restaurant food.
Slow him down — Aqua Needle (Rune of Currents) works, or speed up your team with wind magic.
Then it's Marisa's team: head to the south gate. Clear the minions first, then face the next Revenant.

sections.heading: Boss Fight: Spookybear-Revenant
steps: The easiest Revenant so far — mostly single-target attacks. Keep healed and burn it down, mopping up its Corpse Knights too.

sections.heading: Rematch: Spookybear-Revenant
steps: The teddy bear returns, tougher this time but still straightforward. Watch HP for its one heavy group attack; the rest is manageable.
After dialogue, escape to the open world — head southeast to Twinhorne. Form a team with Nowa, Seign, and Marisa, heal up, and head north through one last beast.
That fight pounds the front row — gear your front-liners with your best armor.

sections.heading: Boss Fight: Experimental Specimen A_0099
steps: Like the lab escape beasts, this one is a grind. Use the Nowa-Marisa-Seign Hero Combo — it's powerful and breaks the enemy's armor.
It targets rows and columns rather than the full team, so split healing between single-target and group recovery as needed.
After more cutscenes, you're ready for the next chapter.

walkthrough.title: The Final Battle! — Various
walkthrough.summary_id: Akhir perang semakin dekat di berbagai lokasi. Kumpulkan seluruh kekuatan terakhirmu untuk pertempuran yang menentukan.
walkthrough.summary_en: The end of the war draws near across multiple locations. Gather all of your remaining strength for the decisive battles.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: The penultimate mission: final preparations, last recruitments, the war for the Imperial capital, and the retaking of Eltisweiss.

sections.heading: Eve of Battle
steps: Back at Castle HQ, head to the Great Hall. You'll need three separate teams again, so plan recruitment and loadouts accordingly:
Equip the best runes you can muster. Pull top accessories and armor from storage. Upgrade lagging weapons at the smithy (up to Lv. 12).
LAST CALL for recruits — the true ending needs all 120. Use the recruitment guide for stragglers.

When truly ready, sleep in Nowa's room. On waking, make the rounds: Seign (top floor), King Euma (third floor), Lian and Mio (second floor left), Melridge (second floor left room), Hildi (second-floor balcony), then Garr back near your room.
After Garr, sleep again. Post-cutscenes, take Nowa to the Great Hall.

sections.heading: The Final Battle (War)
steps: Tell Melridge 'Yes. It's time.' Ignore the Kenani and Revenants in your planning — focus your best legions on the Dux.
After a couple of turns Kallathor announces 'he's here!' — the dendriarch, a Treefolk beast evening the odds against the Dux's dragon. More allies pile in after turn 2.
With the reinforcements you can hardly lose — just keep charging the Dux's forces.

sections.heading: The Imperial Army Headquarters
steps: Tip: put Yaelu in the support slot to reduce random encounters en route.
No chests in the first stretch — just push right across the battleground to your destination.
Inside the HQ proper, still no chests — head north around the barricades. Save at the save point, then advance.
You expected the Dux, but someone else bars the way.

sections.heading: Boss Battle: Heinrich
steps: Heinrich plus two Imperial Elites. Drop the Elites fast — minor individually, but their chip damage adds up.
Heinrich is far weaker to magic than physical. Buff armor and magic defense alike.
He falls, the Dux escapes, and you've defended your town — for now.

sections.heading: Declaring Victory
steps: Regain Nowa, head to the town square, and deliver the victory speech. The following scenes differ based on whether you recruited everyone.
Then comes the next mission: with every other city liberated, it's time to retake Eltisweiss.

sections.heading: Retaking Eltisweiss (War)
steps: Some legions auto-advance each turn — fine. Turns 1–2: charge everything forward.
Turn 3: Nowa's Cross Boost + Vorrdice's Overall Boost, then charge again.
If needed after turn 3, use Sumire's Rescue to restore attacking legions' stamina. One more turn should break Chapell's legion and retake the city.
Not done: form a team and enter the city. Fight grunts heading north, three waves total. Heal after the third, head left, and face Chapell.

sections.heading: Boss Battle: Chapell
steps: Kill his minions first so short-range heroes can reach him.
Keep magic defense up (Water Veil) — Thor's Hammer can devastate a single target. He lacks strong group attacks otherwise.
Use a fast member to feed healing items at turn start if needed.
After the celebration cutscenes, head to the Great Hall for your true final assignment.

walkthrough.title: An Unexpected Ally — Castle Harganthia
walkthrough.summary_id: Marisa dan para Guardian bersatu dengan sekutu yang tak terduga untuk melawan para Revenant di Kastil Harganthia.
walkthrough.summary_en: Marisa and the Guardians unite with an unexpected ally to fight the Revenants at Castle Harganthia.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: An unexpected ally joins, then you delve Castle Harganthia's gear-and-plant dungeon for two final bosses.

sections.heading: The Way Forward
steps: Wake at Castle HQ, visit the Great Hall. After a somber beat, wander the castle overhearing party-member conversations (east 2F, war room via east 2F door, Marisa's room NE 3F, SE 3F, courtyard via NE 1F door, near stockroom 1F, west 1F, NW 2F room, 2F balcony; around town: pasturage, inn, hot spring/NE corner, trading post 1F).
Then find the original Watch members on 1F, return to the Great Hall, and rally the troops.
Heed the strategist: recruit more allies via the guide. After recruiting at least one or two, a town-square disturbance introduces Markus, King of the Revenants — who joins you.
Plan the Revenant army takedown, return to the Great Hall, prep, and tell Melridge to begin. Form your team (some protagonists unavailable) and cross the chain to Castle Harganthia.
To change party mid-mission, cross back and talk to Ymir.

sections.heading: Into Castle Harganthia
steps: Mysterious plants block paths — interact with their flowers to destroy them. The first hides a chest: Pearl Bangle.
Head north, destroy the right-side plant, and loot the blue chest right of the stairs: Rune of Impassable Resistance. Head inside.
Cross the first gear chamber; stop at the marked position for a red chest: Anti-Seal Scarf.
Outside again, go right and loot the southern path's red chest: Rune of Arcane Magic. Then north and right to destroy the blocking plant's flower.
Next square: destroy the southern plant, then all the way right for two more. Head north, take the left side path for a Warded Ribbon (protects frail characters), then re-enter the castle.
Follow the gears; at the branch, go right first for the chest. After dismounting, go left for Faded Book, Chapter 9, then follow the right path to its end: Rune of SP Charge.
Back left across the gears; dismount left for a blue chest: Mystical Bangle (resistance + armor). Head north, wind up the stairs and branch.

Outside on the rooftop: pass under the branch archway, circle south to destroy the first flower. Keep south, go all the way west, then north for the last flower. Take the southeast staircase for a Rune of Rapid Shot, then enter through the north window.
Follow the path to a gear, ride a platform down, head left to activate the reverser, climb back, and cross to the other side.
Up the stairs, drop from the gear — but instead of reversing for the main path, take the LEFT lower gear, dismount on the left metal pipe: Ruby Bangle (strength).
Repeat the gear process on the upper set: drop, reverse, climb, cross both gears. One more gear is branch-blocked, so take the stairs up.
Top of stairs: destroy the flower, grab the red chest: Rune of Runeshard Studies. Back down, drop through the two right gears.
Head south; near the save point, cross the big right gear. Before exiting, drop to the pipe below: Elemental Symbol. Then exit.

Outside, cross the left branch, take the south stairs on the far side: Rune of Blessed Luck chest. For the last pre-boss chest, destroy the far-east flower, then grab the northern-corner blue chest: Material Symbol.
Save and enter the Great Hall.

sections.heading: Boss Battle: Dead Countess
steps: One of the toughest fights yet. Conserve SP for all-enemy attacks — she summons minions.
Keep magic defense up; all her attacks are magical (minions may hit physically).
Even though long-range heroes can hit her, kill the minions first so your short-range heavies can reach her sooner.

sections.heading: Boss Battle: Diradhe
steps: Listen to Diradhe's lines — they're your cue sheet. Above all, use Break whenever available.
Phase 1: Counter when he says 'This is none of your affair, child' or 'Perish!' Otherwise attack.
Phase 2: Counter on 'Loathsome creature!', 'Perish!', or 'No mere Guardian will stand in my way!'
After the cutscenes you're back to Nowa at Castle HQ — time for the final battle.

walkthrough.title: Gardhaven Castle — Gardhaven Castle
walkthrough.summary_id: Konfrontasi terakhir melawan Dux di Kastil Gardhaven untuk mengakhiri perang. Semua yang kamu bangun bermuara di titik ini.
walkthrough.summary_en: The final confrontation with the Dux at Gardhaven Castle to end the war. Everything you have built leads to this point.

sections.heading: Overview
steps: The final dungeon: storm Gardhaven Castle, solve the library book puzzle, and defeat Narungarde, Alde Dracare, and Dux Aldric himself.

sections.heading: Storming the Dux's Castle (War)
steps: Turn 1: charge all legions forward. Turn 2: Nowa's Legion Command to boost attack, Seign's and Kassius's Commands on the Dux, Goldwyn's Command — then end the turn WITHOUT moving.
Staying put baits the Dux into charging your outnumbering force. Turn 3: Vorrdice's Overall Boost, then charge the Dux.
Keep charging; once a unit reaches the northernmost gate you breach the castle.

sections.heading: Gardhaven Castle
steps: You start at a door sealed with red and blue lights. Head right to begin.
Follow the path (skip the first left door), take the second door up a floor. Go right, then all the way north to a glowing blue rune: the Blue Lens (opens blue-sealed doors).
Further left: red chest with a Rune of Medical Studies.
Back down the stairs to the lower hall; go north and open the left blue door for the Sacred Helmet.
Back in the main chamber, take the left path. The right-hand door (Blue Lens) holds the Holy Circlet. The second right door (blue) has the Blessed Shield.
Far north: a corner chest in the last room with a Rune of Supersonic Speed.
Leave, take the unexplored hallway path upstairs. On 2F, skip the right path first; follow the south path to its end: Rune of the Knight's Path chest.
Double back right: first north room has a restaurant recipe chest; next north room an Ascent Badge (big EXP); next north room a Rune of SP+.
Keep right; before the stairs, follow the path to its end: Rune of Tremendous Power. Then ascend to the Dux's library.

sections.heading: Gardhaven Castle Library
steps: Three statues have book-shaped slots. Go upstairs, then right, hugging bookshelves until Nowa shows an interaction arrow — enter the shelf-guarded nook for a blue chest: Book of Knowledge.
Slot it into the LEFT statue at the entrance to raise a shelf.
On the left side past the stairs, interact with the shelf for a red chest: Rune of Quick Movement (optional but nice).
Up the stairs, far right: red chest with Faded Book, Chapter 17.
Return to the raised shelf by the staircase, go up behind the shelves, keep right to another staircase, down and right for a blue chest: Book of Power.
Slot it into the RIGHT statue to raise another shelf.
Back where you found the Book of Power, go all the way left down the new secret passage, hugging shelves for the interaction arrow — this lifts a shelf revealing the Book of Fate.
Slot the final book; the northern shelf lifts. Save and heal — major boss ahead.

sections.heading: Boss Battle: Narungarde
steps: Expect an extremely tough magic-heavy fight — keep Water Veil up.
Speed is key: slow her with Aqua Needle or speed your team with Storm Front.
She escapes when beaten. Continue on to collect the Red Lens; the secret path opens. Head left back to 2F — well positioned.
On the way: left blue door (new lens) hides a red chest with a Blessed Heavy Helm. Back on 1F, watch left for a red door with Blessed Heavy Armor.
Return to the main hall; heal at the outside innkeeper if needed. Enter the north door, and when ready, interact with the central platform.

sections.heading: Boss Battle: Alde Dracare
steps: Phase 1: mostly single-target attacks. Grab the speed advantage however you can. Use Hero Combos sparingly if the participants act after the dragon — one attack can trap your other heroes; use the gimmick to free trapped heroes (may take a couple of hits).

Phase 2: the dragon returns with more magic — keep Water Veil up. Burn through your Runeshards now (the Earth V shards from drops are great damage negation). Spend items freely; there's no reason to hoard anymore.

sections.heading: Final Boss: Dux Aldric
steps: Like the other duels, build tension and use Break whenever charged to advance phases. Dialogue cues dictate your other actions:
Phase 1: Counter on 'My plans for the world will not be impeded!' Otherwise attack.
Phase 2: Counter on 'I am weary to death of your preaching!', 'Simple-minded whelp!', or 'You know nothing!'
Phase 3: Counter on 'I will not be lectured by you, Guardian!' or 'Humanity has a right to wield the lenses. It is our destiny to attain that technology!'
After the last phase, choose Break. You've done it — watch the credits and the per-hero epilogues. Post-game exploration and New Game+ await.

minigames.summary_id: Pertarungan gasing di arena: luncurkan gasingmu, pakai Boost untuk menyerang dari tepi arena, dan menangkan clash dengan button-mashing.
minigames.summary_en: Spinning-top battles in an arena: launch your top, use Boost to strike from the arena's edge, and win clashes with button-mashing.

p_id: Beigoma mulai di Eltisweiss. Temui Reid di bagian barat daya kota untuk mempelajari dasar-dasarnya. Gasing pertamamu bisa ditemukan di rumah Dr. Corque di tenggara Eltisweiss. Setelah itu, kumpulkan 60 gasing dari drop monster dan dengan mengalahkan para pelatih yang tersebar di dunia.
p_en: Beigoma starts in Eltisweiss. Meet Reid in the southwest part of town to learn the basics. Your first tops can be found at Dr. Corque's house in southeast Eltisweiss. After that, collect 60 tops from monster drops and by defeating trainers scattered across the world.

p_id: Luncurkan gasingmu ke arena lalu arahkan gerakannya. Setiap gasing punya stat: HP (diturunkan dari level dan rarity), Attack, Defense, dan nilai elemen yang memberi pengali damage. Rumus damage dasarnya adalah Attack dikali pengali elemen dikurangi Defense lawan, plus nilai acak 1-5. Gunakan Boost untuk melesat dan menghantam lawan dari tepi arena — serangan dari posisi ini memberi damage bonus.
p_en: Launch your top into the arena and steer its movement. Each top has stats: HP (derived from level and rarity), Attack, Defense, and elemental values that grant a damage multiplier. The basic damage formula is Attack times the elemental multiplier minus the opponent's Defense, plus a random 1-5. Use Boost to dash and slam opponents from the arena's edge — attacks from this position deal bonus damage.

p_id: Clash terjadi saat kamu dan lawan mengaktifkan Boost di saat yang bersamaan. Layar akan meminta kedua pemain menekan tombol secepat mungkin — siapa yang lebih cepat memenangkan clash dan memberi damage besar berdasarkan stat Clash Power gasingnya. Peluang memicu clash yang sukses adalah 50% ditambah 10% per tingkat rarity terendah dari kedua gasing.
p_en: A Clash triggers when you and your opponent activate Boost at the same time. The screen prompts both players to mash the button as fast as possible — whoever is faster wins the clash and deals heavy damage based on their top's hidden Clash Power stat. The chance of a successful clash is 50% plus 10% per rarity tier of the lower-rarity top.

p_id: Kalahkan para pelatih Beigoma untuk mendapatkan gasing langka: Taq, Fender, Celera, Venom, Thudd, Zeph, Flowe, Pyre, dan Crash. Menyelesaikan rangkaian ini juga merekrut Dr. Corque dan Reid ke markasmu. Tips: pilih gasing dengan Attack tinggi melawan lawan ber-Defense rendah, dan simpan Boost untuk momen clash atau serangan tepi arena.
p_en: Defeat the Beigoma trainers to earn rare tops: Taq, Fender, Celera, Venom, Thudd, Zeph, Flowe, Pyre, and Crash. Completing this chain also recruits Dr. Corque and Reid to your HQ. Tips: pick high-Attack tops against low-Defense opponents, and save your Boost for clash moments or edge-of-arena strikes.

minigames.summary_id: Lempar kail di titik pancing bertanda ikon joran biru, tangkap ikan untuk bahan masakan Kurtz.
minigames.summary_en: Cast your line at fishing spots marked with blue rod icons, catch fish for Kurtz's cooking ingredients.

p_id: Kamu bisa bertemu Huang di Arenside, di samping jembatan tempat kamu pertama kali melihat Nowa di awal permainan. Dia memberimu Bamboo Rod yang bisa langsung dipakai memancing. Ikan hasil tangkapan nantinya dipakai sebagai bahan masakan di dapur Kurtz.
p_en: You can meet Huang in Arenside, next to the bridge where you first see Nowa at the very start of the game. He gives you a Bamboo Rod you can use right away. Caught fish are later used as cooking ingredients in Kurtz's kitchen.

p_id: Titik pancing ditandai ikon joran biru — biasanya di dekat perairan seperti dermaga. Dekati titiknya dan tekan tombol interaksi untuk mulai; pelampung merah akan terlempar ke air. Saat pelampung tertarik sepenuhnya ke bawah, tekan tombol lagi untuk mengail. Waktu yang tepat menentukan keberhasilan tangkapan.
p_en: Fishing spots are marked with a blue rod icon — usually near water like docks. Approach the spot and press the interact button to begin; a red bobber lands on the water. When the bobber is pulled fully under, press the button again to reel in. Good timing determines whether you land the catch.

p_id: Seekor Wheel Eye Bream dibutuhkan untuk merekrut Huang di Hishahn, jadi simpan satu. Rajin memancing di tiap daerah baru karena jenis ikan berbeda per lokasi — semuanya berguna sebagai bahan masakan.
p_en: A Wheel Eye Bream is needed to recruit Huang in Hishahn, so keep one. Fish regularly in each new region since fish types differ by location — all are useful as cooking ingredients.

minigames.summary_id: Susun dek 160 kartu bersama Glen, mainkan kombinasi warna dan angka untuk mengumpulkan poin dan crown.
minigames.summary_en: Build a 160-card deck with Glen, play color and number combos to collect points and crowns.

p_id: Setelah tokomu dibangun dan Glen direkrut, kamu bisa mulai menyusun dek sendiri dan membeli paket kartu. Total ada 160 kartu setelah toko di-upgrade penuh.
p_en: Once your shop is built and Glen is recruited, you can start building your own deck and buying card packs. There are 160 cards in total once the shop is fully upgraded.

p_id: Setiap kartu punya warna, angka, dan skill karakter yang unik. Sebelum ronde, atur komposisi dekmu untuk keunggulan taktis. Tiap giliran: buang 1 kartu, mainkan 1 kartu, dan letakkan 3 kartu. Kumpulkan poin dan crown dari kombinasi: urutan angka (2 poin, 1 crown), semua warna sama (2 poin, 1 crown), semua angka sama (3 poin, 2 crown), atau urutan angka dengan warna sama (5 poin, 3 crown).
p_en: Each card has a color, a number, and a unique character skill. Before a round, adjust your deck composition for tactical advantage. Each turn: discard 1 card, play 1 card, and lay down 3 cards. Score points and crowns from combos: numerical order (2 points, 1 crown), all the same color (2 points, 1 crown), all the same number (3 points, 2 crowns), or numerical order in the same color (5 points, 3 crowns).

p_id: Fokus bangun dek di sekitar satu atau dua warna agar kombinasi warna sama lebih mudah terbentuk. Kartu dengan skill karakter kuat bisa membalikkan keadaan — baca efeknya sebelum memasukkan ke dek.
p_en: Focus your deck around one or two colors so same-color combos form more easily. Cards with strong character skills can turn a round around — read their effects before adding them to your deck.

minigames.summary_id: Masak hidangan penyembuh dan buff bersama Kurtz, lalu menangkan Duel Masak dengan hidangan 3-course.
minigames.summary_en: Cook healing and buff dishes with Kurtz, then win the Cooking Battle with a 3-course meal.

p_id: Setelah merekrut Kurtz, kamu bisa membangun dapur di markas (di dalam Inn) dan memasak makanan dengan berbagai efek jika punya bahan yang tepat. Ada resep penyembuh dan resep buff. Bicaralah pada Kurtz setiap kembali ke markas untuk memberinya resep baru yang kamu temukan — ini membuka hidangan baru untuk dimasak dan dipakai di duel masak.
p_en: After recruiting Kurtz, you can build a kitchen at HQ (inside the Inn) and cook food with various effects if you have the right ingredients. There are healing and buff recipes. Talk to Kurtz every time you return to HQ to give him new recipes you find — this unlocks new dishes to cook and use in cooking battles.

p_id: Saat kamu menyorot resep yang bahannya kurang, tekan tombol How to Obtain untuk melihat di mana bahan itu bisa didapat. Di bawah daftar hidangan, kamu bisa melihat efek hidangan yang disorot pada orang yang memakannya.
p_en: When you highlight a recipe with missing ingredients, press the How to Obtain button to see where you can get them. Below the dish list, you can see the effect the highlighted dish has on whoever eats it.

p_id: Di restoran, bicaralah pada pria berjas chef putih di kanan konter — Tall Fry. Dia akan mengejek masakan Kurtz dan menantangnya duel. Empat karakter dari partymu dipilih jadi juri; perhatikan makanan favorit masing-masing karena menyajikan favorit mereka memberi poin maksimal untuk hidangan 3-course-mu. Setelah hidangan dipilih, kamu punya 45 detik untuk menekan tombol A secepat mungkin menyemangati Kurtz dan mengisi meter di kiri atas. Setelah penuh, kamu bisa menekan lebih santai. Ulangi beberapa ronde hingga juri memberi nilai akhir.
p_en: At the restaurant, talk to the man in white chef's attire to the right of the counter — Tall Fry. He'll insult Kurtz's food and challenge him. Four characters from your party are chosen as judges; check each one's favorite food since serving their favorites scores maximum points for your 3-course meal. Once dishes are chosen, you have 45 seconds to mash the A button cheering Kurtz on and filling the meter at the top left. Once it's full, you can tap more slowly.
