Repeat for several rounds until the judges give their final score.

minigames.summary_id: Beli murah di satu kota, jual mahal di kota lain. Panah biru berarti murah, panah merah berarti mahal.
minigames.summary_en: Buy low in one town, sell high in another. Blue arrows mean cheap, red arrows mean expensive.

p_id: Di beberapa kota kamu akan menemukan pusat perdagangan. Cara kerjanya seperti bursa: beli produk saat harganya rendah di satu kota, lalu jual dengan harga premium di kota lain. Setiap pusat menunjukkan harga murah atau mahal dengan satu atau dua panah biru ke atas, atau satu atau dua panah merah ke bawah. Harga berubah seiring waktu, jadi pantau terus.
p_en: In several towns you'll find trading centers. They work like a stock market: buy products at a low rate in one town, then sell them at a premium in another. Each center shows low or high prices with one or two blue up arrows, or one or two red down arrows. Prices change over time, so keep watching.

p_id: Werne Village, Treefolk Village, Hishahn, dan Twinhorne East. Merekrut Carrie membuka fast travel antar trading post sehingga rotasimu jauh lebih cepat.
p_en: Werne Village, Treefolk Village, Hishahn, and Twinhorne East. Recruiting Carrie unlocks fast travel between trading posts, making your route much faster.

p_id: Trading adalah cara tercepat menghasilkan baqua untuk membeli rune dan perlengkapan mahal. Beli saat panah biru ganda, jual saat panah merah ganda di kota lain. Jangan menimbun terlalu lama karena harga bisa berbalik.
p_en: Trading is the fastest way to earn baqua for expensive runes and gear. Buy at double blue arrows, sell at double red arrows in another town. Don't hoard too long since prices can swing back.

minigames.summary_id: Rawat, latih, dan balapkan Eggfoot-mu. Menangkan buah untuk memberi skill baru.
minigames.summary_en: Raise, train, and race your Eggfoots. Win fruits that grant new skills.

p_id: Eggfoot adalah makhluk bulat mirip reptil/burung yang awalnya kamu temui sebagai musuh di alam liar. Setelah merekrut Paquia dan Mandie, kamu bisa membangun kandang Eggfoot di markas dan memelihara bayi Eggfoot sendiri.
p_en: Eggfoots are round reptile/bird-like creatures you first meet as enemies in the wild. After recruiting Paquia and Mandie, you can build Eggfoot stables at your HQ and raise baby Eggfoots of your own.

p_id: Di kandang sisi barat kastilmu, kamu bisa membalap, mengkustomisasi, memberi makan, mengembangbiakkan, dan mempensiunkan Eggfoot. Saat menang balapan, kamu diberi buah-buahan untuk dimakan Eggfoot — masing-masing memberi skill acak yang memperkuat mereka untuk balapan berikutnya. Jumlah skill terbatas dan buahnya acak, jadi pilih dengan hati-hati Eggfoot mana yang diberi makan.
p_en: At the stables on the west side of your castle, you can race, customize, feed, breed, and retire your Eggfoots. When you win races, you're rewarded with fruits to feed them — each grants a random skill that strengthens them for future races. Skill slots are limited and fruits are random, so choose carefully which Eggfoot gets fed.

p_id: Sebelum memilih Eggfoot, lihat kekuatan medan dan rintangannya lalu pilih lintasan yang cocok. Perhatikan juga bintang di bagian grade — pastikan level Eggfoot-mu cukup untuk lintasan itu. Semakin sering balapan, semakin banyak piala (cup) yang terbuka. Saat balapan, Eggfoot bergerak sendiri; tugasmu mengatur strategi lewat persiapan yang tepat.
p_en: Before picking an Eggfoot, check its terrain and obstacle strengths and choose a matching track. Also watch the stars under the grade section — make sure your Eggfoot is leveled enough for the track. The more you race, the more cups unlock. During races your Eggfoot does the running itself; your job is strategy through proper preparation.

minigames.summary_id: Pilih aktor yang cocok dengan perannya, pentaskan naskah, dan raih rating penonton terbaik.
minigames.summary_en: Cast actors that fit their roles, stage scripts, and earn the best audience rating.

p_id: Dengan bantuan Clarke dan partymu, warga kota kastil bisa menikmati hiburan teater. Di sisi barat kota, setelah dibangun, Clarke menjalankan pertunjukan panggung dengan aktor pilihanmu. Orang yang kamu tempatkan di peran tertentu mengubah jalannya cerita — cocokkan karakter dengan kepribadian perannya. Di akhir pertunjukan, penonton memberi rating.
p_en: With Clarke's help and your party, your castle town villagers can enjoy theater entertainment. On the west side of town, once built, Clarke runs a stage show with actors of your choice. Who you cast in each role changes how the story plays out — match characters to their roles' personalities. At the end of the show, the audience gives a rating.

p_id: Sebelum bisa mementaskan banyak lakon, kamu harus menemukan naskahnya dan membawanya ke Iris untuk ditambahkan ke teater. Semuanya adalah drop langka di toko umum/toko perkakas di area tertentu: Red Riding Hood (Kyshiri Village), Cinderella (Treefolk Village, 30.000 baqua), Forest Musicians (Yarnaan, 15.000 baqua), Rising (Eltisweiss, 40.000 baqua). Stok toko reset setiap 30 menit waktu bermain — kalau yang dicari belum ada, lakukan aktivitas lain dulu lalu cek lagi.
p_en: Before you can stage multiple plays, you must find their scripts and bring them to Iris to add to the theater. They're all rare drops at general/tool shops in specific areas: Red Riding Hood (Kyshiri Village), Cinderella (Treefolk Village, 30,000 baqua), Forest Musicians (Yarnaan, 15,000 baqua), Rising (Eltisweiss, 40,000 baqua). Shop stock resets every 30 minutes of playtime — if what you want isn't there, do another activity for a while and check back.

p_id: Clarke memberi catatan siapa yang cocok untuk peran apa — dengarkan sarannya. Kepribadian aktor sangat memengaruhi rating akhir, jadi jangan asal pilih karakter favoritmu.
p_en: Clarke notes who fits which role — listen to his advice. Actor personality heavily affects the final rating, so don't just pick your favorite characters.

minigames.summary_id: Masuki portal merah di Castle Underground, pilih mode tantangan, dan naikkan level party dengan cepat.
minigames.summary_en: Enter the red portal in the Castle Underground, pick a challenge mode, and level your party fast.

p_id: Selbineth menawarkan kejutan menarik sekaligus cara cepat menaikkan level anggota party yang tertinggal tanpa harus berkeliling peta. Dia mengelola Hero's Proving Ground di Castle Underground. Untuk ke sana, gunakan salah satu batu teleportasi bercahaya — kamu akan tiba tepat di samping portal merah bercahaya dengan pola yang sama. Dekati dan masuki portalnya.
p_en: Selbineth offers an interesting surprise and a great way to level up lagging party members without running all over the map. She runs the Hero's Proving Ground in the Castle Underground. To get there, use one of the glowing teleportation rocks — you'll arrive right next to a glowing red portal with the same pattern. Approach and enter it.

p_id: Bicaralah pada Selbineth dan pilih mode yang ingin dicoba. Awalnya hanya Normal Mode yang tersedia; mode lain terbuka seiring progres. Pertarungannya seperti battle biasa saat eksplorasi, tapi musuhnya lebih kuat. Di antara boss kamu bisa mengganti anggota party — manfaatkan kelemahan boss untuk menyusun party.
p_en: Talk to Selbineth and select which mode to try. Initially only Normal Mode is available; more modes unlock as you progress. Battles work like regular exploration battles, but enemies are stronger here. Between bosses you can swap party members — exploit boss weaknesses when building your party.

p_id: Hadiah utamanya adalah EXP cepat untuk partymu. Bawa anggota level rendah ke sini untuk mengejar ketertinggalan dengan cepat. Siapkan persediaan penyembuh karena musuh di sini lebih tangguh dari area story setara.
p_en: The main reward is fast EXP for your party. Bring low-level members here to catch up quickly. Stock up on healing supplies since enemies here hit harder than story areas of similar level.

facilities.summary_id: Bangun dan kembangkan markasmu: buka Drafting Studio, kirim misi guild, dan rekrut karakter untuk fasilitas khusus.
facilities.summary_en: Build and grow your headquarters: unlock the Drafting Studio, send guild missions, and recruit characters for special facilities.

p_id: Castle HQ — atau Kota Kamu — adalah fitur besar yang terbuka di Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. Setelah Nowa dan timnya kalah dari kekaisaran di chapter The Eltisweiss Front, sisa Watch dan para penyintas berkumpul di kastil terbengkalai yang kamu temukan sebelumnya dan menjadikannya markas aliansi.
p_en: The Castle HQ — your Town — is a major feature unlocked in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. After Nowa and his team are defeated by the empire in The Eltisweiss Front chapter, the remaining Watch and stragglers regroup in the abandoned castle you found earlier and turn it into the alliance's headquarters.

p_id: Fungsi Castle HQ terbuka selama chapter cerita Hoisting the Alliance Banner. Setelah membereskan barang dan menghabiskan waktu membangun ulang kastil, kamu bertemu Ymir dan rekan-rekan Nowa. Di sini kamu diperkenalkan pada Gocteau (pemimpin guild), Iris (arsitek), dan Caine (pengelola gudang). Terakhir, kamu harus memilih nama untuk kastilmu — ada beberapa opsi, dan memilih 'Let me think it over' menampilkan lebih banyak pilihan. Pilih nama yang kamu suka karena sifatnya permanen.
p_en: The Castle HQ functions unlock during the story chapter Hoisting the Alliance Banner. After settling in and spending time rebuilding the castle, you meet up with Ymir and Nowa's companions. Here you're introduced to Gocteau (a guild leader), Iris (an architect), and Caine (a warehouse manager). Lastly, you must pick a name for your castle — you're given a few options, and selecting 'Let me think it over' shows more. Settle on a name you like since it's permanent.

p_id: Setelah perkenalan, turun ke lantai utama kastil untuk berkenalan dengan Development dan Drafting Studio. Pertama kali turun, kamu otomatis berbicara dengan Iris soal mengelola dan mengembangkan kastil. Cara mengembangkan HQ cukup langsung: kamu butuh dana dari HQ Funds, Material (bisa dikumpulkan dari overworld atau diproduksi di kotamu sendiri — belum tersedia di awal), plus memenuhi prasyarat lain yang tercantum pada bangunan yang ingin dikembangkan. Kamu harus membangun node penghubung terlebih dahulu untuk membuka node lanjutan di pohon Drafting Studio. Di awal tidak perlu terlalu dipikirkan — kalau butuh mengurus kota, bicaralah pada Iris.
p_en: Once introduced, head downstairs to the castle's main floor to get acquainted with Development and the Drafting Studio. The first time you go down you'll automatically talk to Iris about managing and developing your castle. Developing your HQ is straightforward: you need money from HQ Funds, Materials (gathered from the overworld or produced in your own town — unavailable at the start), plus any other prerequisites listed on the structure you want to develop. You must build the connecting node first to reach further nodes in the Drafting Studio tree. At the very start don't overthink it — if you need to work on your town, just talk to Iris.

p_id: Setelah menaikkan Castle HQ ke level 2, kamu membuka riset Mission Guild di Drafting Studio. Ini memungkinkanmu mengirim anggota party yang tidak dipakai — yang ditinggal di kastil — ke berbagai misi dari papan misi. Kamu mendapat beragam material dari misi yang selesai, dan misinya berjalan real-time (waktunya tampil di kanan atas misi yang dipilih). Sebaiknya selalu manfaatkan papan misi agar waktumu efisien. Tidak semua karakter bisa ikut misi, dan tiap karakter punya spesialisasi berbeda: Garr dan Mio menaikkan Physical Strength party, Lian dan Seign menaikkan Charisma, Hildi menaikkan Foraging, Iugo dan Yusuke menaikkan Luck — masing-masing dengan peringkat A/B/C yang berbeda.
p_en: After raising your Castle HQ to level 2, you unlock the Mission Guild research in the Drafting Studio. This lets you send unused party members left behind at your castle on missions from the mission board. You earn various materials from completed missions, and they run in real time (shown at the top-right of your selected mission). We recommend always using the mission board to be efficient with your time. Not all characters are eligible, and each has different specializations: Garr and Mio raise party Physical Strength, Lian and Seign raise Charisma, Hildi raises Foraging, Iugo and Yusuke raise Luck — each with different A/B/C ratings.

p_id: Sekutu adalah sumber kekuatan utamamu dalam mengembangkan HQ, dan karakter tertentu dibutuhkan untuk fasilitas tertentu. Contoh fasilitas HQ level 1: Achievement Society (800 Baqua + Iron Ore x4, butuh Chron), Pasturage (300 Baqua + Lumber x20, butuh Martha), Quarry (300 Baqua + Lumber x20, butuh Ormond), Woodcutter's Cabin (300 Baqua + Stone x20, butuh Kerrin), Farm (1600 Baqua, butuh Pieter), Smithy (1000 Baqua + Stone x50, butuh Douglas), Hot Spring (1000 Baqua + Lumber x30, butuh Faye), Trading Post, Inn, dan lainnya. Karena fasilitas dan rekrutmen karakter saling terkait, prioritaskan merekrut karakter yang membuka bangunan yang kamu butuhkan.
p_en: Allies are your main source of power for developing your HQ, and certain characters are required for certain facilities. Example level-1 HQ facilities: Achievement Society (800 Baqua + Iron Ore x4, needs Chron), Pasturage (300 Baqua + Lumber x20, needs Martha), Quarry (300 Baqua + Lumber x20, needs Ormond), Woodcutter's Cabin (300 Baqua + Stone x20, needs Kerrin), Farm (1600 Baqua, needs Pieter), Smithy (1000 Baqua + Stone x50, needs Douglas), Hot Spring (1000 Baqua + Lumber x30, needs Faye), Trading Post, Inn, and more. Since facilities and character recruitment go hand in hand, prioritize recruiting characters that unlock the buildings you need.

p_id: Divination Parlor adalah fasilitas kastil unik yang mempekerjakan peramal B'baba — dia bisa membantumu menemukan calon sekutu dengan biaya kecil 300 Baqua. Untuk merekrut dan membangunnya, mulai dulu quest rekrutmen Faye dengan menaikkan kotamu ke level 2, lalu temui dia di jalan barat. Setelah itu seorang prajurit menyarankan memakai jasa B'baba: pergi ke Daphan dan bicaralah padanya di rumah sudut barat laut. Lalu lanjutkan menangkap Faye dan selesaikan rekrutmennya. Setelah semua beres, riset fasilitas Divination Parlor seharga 1600 Baqua. Selain menemukan sekutu potensial, Parlor juga memberi info latar dan lore anggota partymu yang sudah direkrut — hingga tiga kali!
p_en: The Divination Parlor is a unique castle facility employing the scryer B'baba — she can help you locate potential allies for a small fee of 300 Baqua. To recruit and build it, first start Faye's recruitment quest by raising your town to level 2, then bump into her on the west road. Afterwards a soldier will suggest seeking B'baba's services: head to Daphan and speak to her in the house at the northwest corner. Then proceed to catch Faye and complete her recruitment. Once that's done, research the Divination Parlor facility for 1600 Baqua. Besides locating potential allies, the Parlor also gives background and lore info for your recruited party members — up to three times!

details.summary_id: Apa yang terbawa ke playthrough kedua dan apa yang direset.
details.summary_en: What carries over to your second playthrough and what gets reset.

p_id: Setelah menyelesaikan misi terakhir di Gardhaven Castle dan menyimpan data post-game, kamu bisa memulai New Game Plus dari menu utama. Kamu akan ditanya apakah ingin mentransfer semua stat dan item — termasuk equipment, rune, dan item simpananmu.
p_en: After completing the final mission at Gardhaven Castle and saving your post-game data, you can start New Game Plus from the main menu. You'll be asked if you want to transfer all your stats and items — including equipment, runes, and stored items.

p_id: Level karakter, equipment, rune-lens, item, dan uang terbawa ke NG+. Semua sekutu yang sudah direkrut juga ikut, sehingga proses upgrade kota di playthrough kedua jauh lebih cepat karena prasyarat karakter sudah terpenuhi.
p_en: Character levels, equipment, rune-lenses, items, and money carry over to NG+. All recruited allies come along too, so upgrading your town in the second playthrough is much faster since character prerequisites are already met.

p_id: Sayangnya progres Castle HQ direset total — termasuk semua material dan pengembangan markas. Kamu harus membangun ulang kotamu dari nol, tapi dengan sekutu yang sudah lengkap, prosesnya jauh lebih singkat dibanding playthrough pertama.
p_en: Unfortunately your Castle HQ progress is fully reset — including all materials and headquarters development. You'll rebuild your town from scratch, but with all allies already recruited the process is much shorter than your first playthrough.

route_notes.how_to: Treat as a steady-state circuit; on each stop unload anything under Sell Here first, then fill back up from the local Buy Here list.
route_notes.carry_over: Hold Leather Clothes for Werne; Pink Coral and Pearl for Treefolk; Painting and Wall Scroll for Hishahn; Rug, Glassware, and Carving for Impershi'arc.
route_notes.unlock_gated: Skip Kimono, Gleaming Orb, and Wall Scroll until they unlock.
route_notes.profit: Estimated profit per circuit: ~110,000 early / ~260,000 unlocked; roughly 4-10 full circuits for the 1,000,000 Baqua trophy.

tips.title: Reset Merchant Stock
tips.text: Play a chef cooking battle or a card game to instantly restock merchants. Buy multiple rounds from the same town without traveling!

tips.title: When to Start
tips.text: Trading unlocks after the first "split up" mission in the story. Start early to build capital for later upgrades.

tips.title: Unlock New Items
tips.text: Some items unlock by maintaining trade profits: Silk -> Kimono (10k profit), Glassware -> Gleaming Orb (5k profit), and Wall Scroll (100k total).

tips.title: HQ Specialties
tips.text: Upgrade your Trading: Specialties facility at HQ to unlock Red Gemstone, Gold Bread, and Clay Figurine - high-value exclusive items.

tips.title: Stack Limits Matter
tips.text: Expensive items like Diamond (stack 5) and Painting (stack 5) have low stacks. Fill remaining inventory with high-stack items like Rock Salt (50) and Corn (50).

tips.title: Buy at Cheapest Point
tips.text: Always buy where the buy price is lowest and sell where the sell price is highest. Check the price tables below for optimal margins.

locations.name: Arenside
locations.description: Arenside is a location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It was first shown with the working title of Camp Village (キャンプ村) in the July 2021 Kickstarter update.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: Located in northern Grum County, the normally sleepy village of Arenside became a hotbed of activity with the potential discovery of a new set of Runebarrows in the nearby Northern Forest. As part of diplomatic efforts between the League of Nations and the Galdean Empire, dual camps were established on the outskirts of the village as they planned their joint investigative operation. It was here that Nowa first began his work for the Eltisweiss Watch and, just as importantly, where he first met Seign Kesling, who led the Imperial contingent during the joint mission. Following the successful discovery of the Northern Runebarrows and the Primal Lens enshrined within, both parties would eventually withdraw, returning the village to its lethargic state some six months later.

locations.description: Fort Xialuke is a location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is a fortress that straddles Grum County and its northern lands.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: Fort Xialuke is a fortress that straddles Grum County and its northern lands. Travel through the fortress is normally routine but is sometimes delayed or blocked, such as when the Eltisweiss Watch were investigating the Northern Runebarrows. The desperado Yusuke would be detained at the fortress on suspicion of banditry.

locations.name: Eltisweiss
locations.description: Eltisweiss is a location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is the central city of Grum County in the League of Nations and the home of Perrielle Grum and the Eltisweiss Watch.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: The main city of Grum County, Eltisweiss is a bustling city under the stewardship of Perrielle Grum. The city and its surrounding lands are protected by Fort Xialuke to the north. Altverden and Werne Villages also lie under its immediate domain. Following the investigation of the Northern Runebarrows in northern Grum County, the Eltisweiss Watch would be based out of Eltisweiss's inn for a time.

locations.name: Werne Village
locations.description: Werne Village is a location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is a small settlement located in northwestern Grum County.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: Located in Grum County, Werne Village had achieved a measure of prosperity in recent times with its local bazaar, an initiative proposed by Perrielle Grum. The village was also known for its Chen Rock Tea, imported from the East Reach. When sightings of bandits increased in Grum County, the people of Werne were particularly concerned. Normalcy returned for a time when the Eltisweiss Watch apprehended the group led by Kogen, Yuthus, and Zabi.

locations.name: Altverden Village
locations.description: Altverden Village is a location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is a small settlement located in southwestern Grum County.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: Located in Grum County, the small village of Altverden came under increased stress from bandit attacks in the months following the investigation of the Northern Runebarrows. The Eltisweiss Watch was charged with investigating the attacks. Nowa 's group was tasked with the duty and would uncover a number of conflicting reports and leads, before eventually following a thread to the Abandoned Mine to Altverden's west and confronting the group led by Kogen, Yuthus, and Zabi. The subduing of this group stopped the immediate issue of Altverden hunter traps being poached.

locations.name: Kyshiri Village
locations.description: Kyshiri Village is a location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is a small country settlement located in an isolated area.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: This small village was separated from Grum County by mountains, traversable through the Mountain Path Homeward. Located to the west, it lay quite close to the League of Nations ' border with the Galdean Empire. The village was the hometown of Nowa. This was the reason his detachment of the Eltisweiss Watch was chosen to investigate bandit reports in the area. Shortly after arriving, the town would be attacked by "bandits", actually agents under the command of Hurstwine, agent of the Empire. Kyshiri Village would be torched in the attack but the villagers were safely evacuated by Seign Kesling and Valentin, minimizing losses.

locations.name: Headquarters
locations.description: The Headquarters is a location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is the player-named base of operations for the Alliance.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: Located southwest of the mountains where Grum County 's Abandoned Mine lay, the headquarters were built atop the old Castle Ruins where Kogen 's bandit crew once made their home. Following the fall of Eltisweiss on The Eltisweiss Front, a band of survivors were able to make there way here through the old mining tunnels and lay the foundations for the Alliance. The Near Headquarters region beyond its walls held several points of bountiful resources perfect for the burgeoning settlement. From a starting population of just 360, the headquarters would gradually expand as a town as more people were recruiting to the Alliance cause, bringing their singular talents to bear.

sections.heading: Name
sections.content: The player has some 100 names to choose from for the headquarters. When the time comes to name the settlement, Nowa will think of three randomly selected names for the player to choose from. The player can dismiss these three choices and have Nowa think of another three names from the list until a name the player is satisfied with appears.

sections.heading: Kickstarter
sections.content: When the player first acquires the fortress town, it will be rather small, but they will be able to grow it over time by recruiting other characters and putting them to work. The player will be able to customize the fortress town by: Building sturdy castle walls to protect from enemy invasions. Expanding military equipment to develop weapons and recruit more troops. Cultivating fields for farming and creating granaries. Creating specialty products to trade in order to develop businesses such as the blacksmith, builders, souvenir shop, and restaurants.

locations.name: The Treefolk Village
locations.description: The Treefolk Village is a location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is the village of the treefolk, nestled deep within the The Greatwood.

sections.heading: History
sections.content: The Treefolk Village is built into part of the treefolk Dendriarch himself. Treefolk tended to live their whole lives in the village, from birth to when they return to the forest with few exceptions, such as Kallathor. Other races were almost never seen in the village. The use of fire is strictly forbidden in the village. Hurstwine and Narungarde would infiltrate the village to steal of the Rune of Proven Verdure and gain access to The Proving Grounds. They were pursued by Marisa 's Guardians, who then joined forces with Nowa to confront the Imperial agents.

locations.name: Twinhorne East
locations.description: Twinhorne East is a location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is a town in western Euchrisse.

sections.heading: History
sections.content: The Euchrissian town of Twinhorne East formed a pair with its Norristar i counterpart, Twinhorne West. Travel between the two was facilitated by ferry. Fishing and trade comprised two of Twinhorne East's major industries, with trade across the Broadwater to Norristar and Kenan being particularly profitable. Relatively isolated, the village was mostly unspoiled by the war between the Alliance and the Galdean Empire. At some point, sightings of The Chelonian Goliath, Vilashnu increased. Together, Nowa and Dijkstra would investigate the behemoth and explore the ruins upon its back.

locations.name: Hishahn Palace
locations.description: Hishahn Palace is a location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is the center of government for Hishahn and Euchrisse in general as the seat of King Euma Siarith.

sections.heading: History
sections.content: Much like Hishahn itself, this iteration of Hishahn Palace is relatively young, being constructed in the aftermath of the flooding that destroyed Hishahn Old Town some years back.

locations.name: Daphan Village
locations.description: Daphan Village is a location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is a small village in eastern Euchrisse.

sections.heading: History
sections.content: Though aways from Hishahn, people in Daphan lauded the village as a center of trade. The village was established by those fleeing the flooding of what is now referred to as Hishahn Old Town. As such, the village used to known as Little Hishahn. Foreigners were a rare sight in Daphan Village. The village had some measure of esteem for being the home of the fortune teller B'baba as well as the famed martial artist Lam. One of Crash 's minions, the beigoma spinadier Venom, operated in Daphan also.

locations.name: Dabavin
locations.description: Dabavin is a location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is a town located on the fringes of the Eastern Desert and Great Sandy Sea.

sections.heading: History
sections.content: Dabavin is a town of the shi'arcs, located in the Eastern Desert and was considered an oasis amongst its sands. Shi'arcraft ferries took travelers and goods from Dabavin across the Great Sandy Sea to Impershi'arc in the east. The town was built into the natural caverns of the area, giving it an impressive verticality and a unique architecture. There was also a large warehouse below the town for storing trade goods. Though human sandwalkers lived with shi'arcs in Dabavin, humans were still an uncommon sight in Dabavin. There was an influx of refugees following the Galdean invasion of Euchrisse.

locations.name: Impershi'arc
locations.description: Impershi'arc is a location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: Impershi'arc is a desert nation and the homeland of the Shi'arc people. The Shi'arc mercenary commander Yuferius VII hails from this nation. Impershi'arc is a village located in the middle of the desert. Its buildings are made of sand bricks. It's a desert village, but there's even a few trees growing on it. The people of Impershi'arc make a living by fishing for sandfish lurking in the desert, and they have sandfish fishing tools such as long harpoons and special nets and benches to dry out their catches.

locations.name: Yarnaan
locations.description: Yarnaan is a location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. This hidden settlement, located deep within the The Greatwood, is the home of the Guardians.

sections.heading: History
sections.content: Yarnaan has existed since ancient times, using rune-lens technology in ways mostly unknown to the outside world. It said that in the past, Yarnaan, as well as the Eldroad, used to be Runebarrows. The Guardians that inhabit Yarnaan hold a duty to ensure that The Greatwood 's Barrows are not compromised by treasure hunters or forces seeking ancient powers for their own ends. The town itself is governed by the Grandwarden. During the war between the Alliance and the Galdean Empire, Yarnaan would be attacked and conquered by the Archrevenant Diradhe 's undead forces as part of his alliance with Narungarde. The village was able to be evacuated without loss but the loss was still felt deeply. Yarnaan would be reclaimed with the Guardian Marisa led an attack on Castle Harganthia, defeating Diradh

locations.name: Ardinale City
locations.description: Ardinale City is a location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is a city located in the Galdean Empire and is the hometown of Seign Kesling and others.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: Ardinale City is a city located in southern Galdea. The city is under the charge of House Kesling, one the Empire's noble houses, and their administration was well praised. The city was considered one of the most prosperous cities in the Galdean Empire. Class disparity was stark in Ardinale, with a Lowtown existing for commoners beneath the main city and a noble district apart from that. When Seign Kesling infiltrated the Empire to make contact with parties opposed to Dux Aldric, he and his colleagues would operate out of a safehouse in the Lowtown district of Ardinale. Following the completion of his mission, he would make a visit to his father, Craigh at the Kesling family estate, where each discussed the motivations behind their respective decisions.

locations.name: Twinhorne West
locations.description: Twinhorne West is a location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is a town in southern Norristar.

sections.heading: History
sections.content: The Norristar i town of Twinhorne West formed a pair with its Euchrisse counterpart, Twinhorne East. The town was sometimes called Port Twinhorne and was known for its large number of ships, which people sometimes traveled to see. Travel between the two towns was facilitated by ferry across the Broadwater. The town would come under Galdean attack following the Imperial victory at the Battle of Athrabalt. To prevent the Alliance withdrawal, the Empire occupied the town and destroyed its ships. The Alliance was able to escape regardless, thanks to the timely repurposing of shi'arc shi'arcraft. The town itself would take longer to recover from the brief occupation, though its inhabitants were hopeful for the future.

sections.content: The small, isolated village of Skriss is blanketed in snow, laying at the foot of the mountains of Snowpeak Pass. A large cave, The Ice Cave lay immediately to its north. Nowa and his companions would journey to the village after Rudy traveled to Athrabalt to solicit help in rescuing the children of the village who had become trapped in the cave.

However, it is solid ground made of compacted sand, making it an island when compared to the much more water-like sands of the Great Sandy Sea. Nowa was able to cast for a variety of fish native to the Great Sandy Sea at a fishing spot here.

locations.name: Athrabalt
locations.description: Athrabalt is a location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is the capital of the Monarchy of Norristar in the League of Nations, ruled by King Sallas Baelrant.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: Capital of Norristar, Athrabalt is a bustling city under the rule of King Sallas Baelrant and defended by General Elektra. Located roughly in the center of Norristar, it is a hub connecting Skriss Village in the north and Twinhorne West in the south. Athrabalt, as the Norristari capital, would be the focus of the Galdean Empire 's advance on the nation. With the revenant takeover of Yarnaan, the people were concerned about their continued advance also. These worries would prove to be warranted when it was revealed that Diradhe 's revenant forces were working in concert with Narungarde. The city would be defended on The Athrabalt Front but a number of factors would see the city lost to the enemy forces.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: This northern Grum County forest became a focus of both the Galdean Empire and the League of Nations when an Arenside resident reported stumbling across a previously-unknown runebarrows there. With the villager unable to recall the exact path, the Empire and League would send a joint reconnaissance team into the area. Areas of the forest were shrouded in an intense mist due to devices in the area designed to obscure the runebarrows. The team were able to deactivate the devices and gain access to the Northern Runebarrows.

locations.name: Runebarrows
locations.description: The Runebarrows, colloquially referred to as simply the Barrows, are ruins located within the Quarry of New Nevaeh. Filled with rune-lenses and other treasures, it is a draw for eager treasure hunters. However, many of the locals believe that the Barrows should not be disturbed.

sections.heading: History
sections.content: After an earthquake in New Nevaeh, the Runebarrows were revealed. Isha, the acting mayor of New Nevaeh, used the Runebarrows as an opportunity to raise money for the town, and invited adventures from all corners to explore them. For an adventurer to be able to explore the Runebarrows, they must purchase an explorer's license for 100,000 baqua. Or, for those who are not financially able, they must complete a Stamp Card. To also aid the town, all artifacts found in the barrows are subject to an explorer tax of thirty percent. After Main Quest 10: The Mystery of the Menhir, CJ, Garoo, and Isha uncovered a secret Menhir, the Farmside Menhir. This provided quick access between New Nevaeh and the Runebarrows. The Runebarrows hide a great secret that has fateful implications for one of the game's

sections.heading: Areas
sections.content: Barrows' Arch In-game description: Entrance to the mysterious Runebarrows, uncovered in the earthquake. The Menhir has made getting in and out much easier.

sections.heading: Grand Passage
sections.content: In-game description: A hallway leading deeper into the Barrows, littered with monsters who wield the power of lightning.

sections.heading: Fishing Spot
sections.content: In-game description: A fishing spot long since forgotten and full of the biggest and rarest fish anyone has ever seen.

locations.name: Redthroat Ridge
locations.description: Redthroat Ridge is a dungeon location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is the first optional dungeon the player will have the option of visiting in the game.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: The desolate Redthroat Ridge was known to be a dangerous area inhabited by vicious monsters. In the six months after the investigation of the Northern Runebarrows, Nowa had completed some tasks for the Eltisweiss Watch in the area. Mellore would take it upon herself to travel to the canyon upon hearing of the risk of the powerful Nerthus that resided there. Nowa and his party would follow her and, after proving their good nature, would assist Mellore in taking down the fierce creature, securing her cooperation with the Watch.

locations.name: Abandoned Mine
locations.description: The Abandoned Mine is a dungeon location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is the third mandatory dungeon the player will visit in the game and was first revealed in the March 2022 Kickstarter update.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: This abandoned mine was located in the vicinity of Altverden Village, immediately to its east. In the past, it had been a plentiful mine with bountiful ore deposits but had since run dry and been left unattended. At first glance, the mine appeared to be a small deposit which access blocked by a landslide, but a secret entrance allow those who knew of it to explore further. When investigating possible bandit hideouts, the Eltisweiss Watch was informed about the mines by the people of Altverden. Investigating, Nowa 's group found themselves on the trail of Kogen, Yuthus, and Zabi, trailing them through the perilous mines before confronting them at their hideout in the Castle Ruins.

sections.heading: Information

Following the establishment of the Alliance, soldiers would carefully explore the forest, having heard rumors of powerful monsters within. These rumors limited exploration, as sections of the forest would only be opened up bit by bit as the reconnaissance mission continued. The woodcutter Kerrin had a small hut at the entrance to the forest. The second section of the forest would only open after the Alliance began their mission to Euchrisse. The final section of the forest would only be cleared for entry at some point following Seign Kesling 's investigations in Ardinale City.

locations.name: The Greatwood – East
locations.description: The Greatwood – East is a dungeon location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. This eastern portion of the Greatwood led to the Treefolk Village.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: This eastern stretch of Allraan 's Greatwood tapered off in the south-east of the Near Headquarters region. The entrance to the forest trail was normally inaccessible as the treefolk would ask the forest to hide their steps. A rune of the treefolk, such as the one Kallathor used allowed treefolk to use what they called the shade trails. That said, the forest was not entirely impenetrable. The magic researcher Gieran conducted research in this area of the Greatwood, hoping to find the Rune of Conservation for use in his magic. The eastern Greatwood path would lead travelers to the Treefolk Village with further paths branching out from there.

locations.description: The Eldroad is a dungeon location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is a secret Guardian path allowing passage through the The Greatwood.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: The Guardians held knowledge of routes and paths hidden to others such as the Eldroad. Some people say that the Eldroad is, or once was, a part of the Runebarrows. In the modern day, the Guardians mostly used the Eldroad to monitor and defend key sites throughout the The Greatwood. When the Galdean Empire began to make designs on Norristar, the Guardian Marisa would reveal the previously hidden Eldroad to the Alliance. Taking the Eldroad allowed Nowa and the others to avoid any imperial pursuers en route to Yarnaan, though the route was not without its own natural dangers, such as the young Elder Dragon protective of its territory.

sections.heading: Information

The capital was then rebuilt in what is now Hishahn by order of King Yule Siarith, though many survivors also moved to Daphan Village. The Euchrissian Lord Councilor Harlan had a manor on the outskirts of Hishahn proper, near Lost Town, making it possible for Nowa 's group to infiltrate his abode from the Lost Town side in their search for evidence of Harlan's collusion with Dux Aldric. It was known that the waterways of Lost Town were infested with monsters, including the fearsome Pagurian. locations.description: The Proving Grounds is a dungeon location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. Located in The Greatwood, it is a runebarrows of significance to the treefolk of Allraan. It would become a target of the Galdean Empire, who were hunting for Primal Lenses in the region.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: The Proving Grounds were a runebarrows located in The Greatwood near The Treefolk Village. The Rune of Proven Verdure, vital to the treefolk, was connected with these ruins. Treefolk came here to seek the blessing of the lens. The treefolk Dendriarch overcame these trials before setting down his eternal roots. Hurstwine and Narungarde would steal the rune to bypass the trials of the Proving Ground and fled into the ruins, in the hopes of a finding a Primal Lens. The Proving Grounds were a complicated structure to navigate, with the layout of floors able to manipulated by the mechanisms within. Without the Rune of Proven Verdure, interacting with these elements were a requirement to find a path through to the barrows' depths. Although relatively sedate research was undertaken at the facility, top-secret work was also in progress, which most researchers were locked out of. When the imperial researcher Ivy discovered this, she would smuggled Yaelu from the facility before making contact with Pohl in Ardinale City while hiding from the dux's pursuit. locations.name: Blocked Highway
locations.description: The Blocked Highway is an encounter location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is not traversable by the player and serves as a set-piece for a series of encounters against monsters as the climax of Seign 's mission in Galdea.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: This Galdean road connected Dux Aldric 's Rune-Lens Research Laboratory, Gardhaven Castle, and Ardinale City. After infiltrating the research laboratory, Seign 's group make their escape using Pohl 's rune-tank, Sylvie. The rune-tank would conspicously make its escape while firing rounds at Gardhaven Castle to draw attention away from the fleeing villagers of Yaelu 's people. Narungarde would appear during their escape and attempt to block their escape with a series of prototype monster weapons borne from Dux Aldric's research, eventually culminating in a battle against a Chimera. Following its defeat, Pohl was able to drive Narungarde off using Sylvie's compression combustor, allowing the group to make it to Ardinale City intact.

locations.name: Shandar Ridge
locations.description: Shandar Ridge is a location shown in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It was first revealed under the working title Desert Border Route (砂漠の境界ルート) in the October 2021 Kickstarter update.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: The Shandar Ridge is a beautiful, naturally occurring maze blocking progress through the deserts of Allraan. Its dry terrain is a deterrent to any potential travelers. Eastern traders often use the Shandar Ridge to travel between the Eastern Desert and Euchrisse and their travel was occasionally stymied by monster attacks. Shandar sand lizards reside in the area but rarely attack humans. They are preyed upon by most vicious creatures and tend to withdraw when they sense danger, such as that from the Surkkamui, one of its more dangerous predators. The Alliance traversed Shandar Ridge with the help of Barnard Sawad in order to meet with the shi'arcs in Impershi'arc and solicit their aid in the Alliance war against the Galdean Empire.

The lens hunter Quinn would recruit Nowa for a job at the Den of the Dunes, hoping to secure a raw lens. There, the duo would encounter the fearsome Oyamatsumi and after a series of fierce battles, would succeed in bringing the monster down. Quinn would secure the high-grade raw lens and in return agreed to join the Alliance. Dijkstra had also traveled to the Den of the Dunes in the hopes of obtaining the raw lens, but seeing the Oyamatsumi made him think better of challenging the foe alone.

Legend held that there was a giant monster living in the heart of the cave. locations.description: Snowpeak Pass, also referred to as Whitecrown Pass, is a dungeon location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is a treacherous mountain range in northern Norristar.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: Snowpeak Pass is a mountain path located in northern Norristar, in the Aegan Northcaps. The area is blanketed by snow year-round in heavy weather. The term Whitecrowns is sometimes used to refer to the pass and the surrounding range. Skriss Village was said to be a Whitecrown village, for example. During the war between the Alliance and the Galdean Empire, Dux Aldric sought to march on Norristar through this pass. The Alliance would anticipate this and made plans to cause an avalanche, blocking the pass, and massively delaying the imperial advance. Unfortunately, the plan was leaked to the Empire by Valmaurice. Although Nowa and his party were able to escape Heinrich 's attention and successfully detonate their runic charges, Aldric had brought enough laborers and engineers to have the pas

locations.name: The Chelonian Goliath, Vilashnu
locations.description: The Chelonian Goliath, Vilashnu is an optional dungeon location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is unlocked by beginning Dijkstra 's recruitment.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: The Chelonian Goliath, Vilashnu is a gigantic stone turtle that resided in the Broadwater, not far from Twinhorne East. People in Twinhorne sometimes reported seeing a huge mountain moving in the sea, this being a sighting of Vilashnu. The turtle was so large as to have an entire dungeon upon its back. The rune-lens treasure hunter Dijkstra would plan an expedition to the Chelonian Goliath and would recruit Nowa to his cause, agreeing to join the Alliance upon completion of the job. Many powerful monsters of renown dwelt upon the turtle's back. After defeating the Goblomancer at Vilashnu's peak, Djikstra secured a hefty amount of raw lens and fulfilled his promise, joining the Alliance.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.content: The term "chelonian" denotes a reptile of the order Testudines including turtles, terrapins, and tortoises. It derives from the Greek word for tortoise χελώνη (chelone).

locations.name: Castle Harganthia
locations.description: Castle Harganthia, initially revealed as the Castle of the Dead Countess (デッドカウンテスの巣くう城), is a Dungeon location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes.

sections.heading: History
sections.content: This castle once belonged to humans, and rumor has it that the castle floats as it does due to the power of a rune-lens cast by a previous ruler. In time, this castle was abandoned, falling into ruins, and that is when the Dead Countess and her kin took up residence inside, turning it into her lair. Nowadays, the interior of the castle is still crumbling, but it is said that the top floor where the Dead Countess resides is furnished with luxurious items in far better shape than the castle’s furnishings, and that the undead hordes raided the surrounding territory to obtain them.

locations.name: Gardhaven Castle
locations.description: Gardhaven Castle is a dungeon location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. Located in Dux Aldric 's territory in the Galdean Empire, Gardhaven Castle is the final dungeon of the game's story.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: This enormous, ornate castle lay within Dux Aldric 's territory and served as his seat of power. There was apparently a Gardhaven Castle Town located in the vicinity.

locations.name: Imperial Army Headquarters
locations.description: The Imperial Army Headquarters is a temporary location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is temporarily available during the story quest The Final Battle following the Last Battle at Headquarters. As a temporary location, it contains no unique missable items or enemies.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: This base camp served as the Galdean army's headquarters for their attack on the Alliance Headquarters. Following the shock defeat at the Last Battle at Headquarters, this base of operations would come under attack from the victorious Alliance, who hoped to find Dux Aldric and put an end to the war. Fighting their way through the Imperial forces, Nowa 's party would eventually catch up to Dux Aldric and General Heinrich. Heinrich would lay down his life to buy Aldric time to escape, fighting the party to the death and unleashing the full power of his rune-lens when he was defeated.

locations.name: Castle Ruins
locations.description: The Castle Ruins is a location in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is temporarily available following completion of the story quest Searching the Tunnels. It becomes unavailable for the remainder of the game following the story quest The Eltisweiss Front.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: These old fortress ruins were accessible from Grum County via the Abandoned Mine west of Altverden Village. When bandits attacked the border village where Kogen and his comrades lived, the refugees would make their way to these old ruins. From there Kogen, Yuthus, and Zabi would resort to steal food and traps from around Altverden to feed their people. When Nowa 's detachment of the Eltisweiss Watch confront Kogen's group in these ruins, the two parties would battle. Afterwards, Kogen would be detained by the Watch while soldiers would be dispatched from Eltisweiss with provisions by Ymir in anticipation of Perrielle Grum 's desires on the matter.

locations.name: Euchrisse
locations.description: The Kingdom of Euchrisse is a region and nation that appears in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes.

sections.heading: History
sections.content: The Kingdom of Euchrisse traces its origins to King Dias Siarith, who is said to have established it in Solar Year 565. Dias, reportedly from a lineage of affluent merchants, is credited with the unification of several small nations, factions, and races, although some sources insinuate he merely bought his way through the throne through his mercantile means. Dias assumed the title of king and instituted the House of Lords with the aim of fostering stability within the nation. The name "Euchrisse" was inspired by an ancient realm purportedly existing in the same region. It is renowned as the "land of water", due to the numerous tributaries of the Eagle River and its location along Allraan's southern coast. Since its foundation, Euchrisse has maintained a policy of amicable relations with ne

sections.heading: Chests
sections.content: Euchrisse contains 1 of the 227 chests required for the Treasure Hunter achievement/trophy.

locations.name: Eastern Desert
locations.description: The Eastern Desert is a region that appears in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes.

sections.heading: History
sections.content: The eastern desert denotes the traversable part of the Great Sandy Sea located immediately east of Euchrisse. Travelers such as traders pass through Shandar Ridge between the desert and Euchrisse. A large meteorite can be seen in the area's north, embedded in a crater and bearing a mysterious message. The shi'arc port town of Dabavin lies at the eastern edge of this patch of desert, with shi'arcraft ferries available in the town to take travelers across the Great Sandy Sea and direct to the shi'arc home of Impershi'arc.

sections.heading: Chests
sections.content: The Eastern Desert contains 1 of the 227 chests required for the Treasure Hunter achievement/trophy.

locations.name: Great Sandy Sea
locations.description: The Great Sandy Sea is a region that appears in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes.

sections.heading: History
sections.content: The Great Sandy Sea denotes the vast desert located east of Dabavin. Shi'arcraft developed by the shi'arcs are used to traverse the sandy seas and fish for Sandfish. Sandfish fishing is how the majority of shi'arc make their livelihoods. According to shi'arc legend, the Great Sandy Sea was discovered by the shi'arc who invented shi'arcraft. The shi'arc homesand of Impershi'arc lies in this desert. The borders of the Galdean Empire also reach the fringes of the Great Sandy Sea. The name Great Sandy Sea has also been given to a majestic shi'arcraft at some point.

sections.heading: Chests
sections.content: The Great Sandy Sea contains 1 of the 227 chests required for the Treasure Hunter achievement/trophy.

locations.name: Norristar
locations.description: The Monarchy of Norristar is a region and nation that appears in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes.

sections.heading: History
sections.content: In Solar Year 527, Frestia Fury founded the Monarchy of Norristar. Its history is rife with warfare. In Solar Year 545, the nation of Kenan, ruled by the Dragonewts, sparked the Kenani-Norristar War, claiming that the territory had always belonged to Kenan. At the start of the war, Kenan had the upper hand. Yet Max Kellan, a lowly lieutenant, managed to salvage the bulk of Norristari forces in a heroic effort. Ascending rapidly to the rank of general, Kellan turned the tide of the war and brought an end to the conflict. In Norristar, his name is still venerated, and many children are named in his honor. In Solar Year 562, an invasion of Norristar by the Galdean Empire was thwarted when King Estaruk led his forces to repel the attackers. Perceiving the Galdean threat even after the war's en

sections.heading: Chests
sections.content: Norristar contains 1 of the 227 chests required for the Treasure Hunter achievement/trophy.

locations.name: Grum County
locations.description: Grum County is a region in Eiyuden Chronicle: Hundred Heroes. It is the second region the player explores in the game.

sections.heading: Information
sections.content: Grum County is considered a minor member of the League of Nations, one of several minor states and polities with membership but without the same influence or power of the League's three major powers. Located near the border between the League of Nations and the Galdean Empire, the larger portion of its lands is divided from northern Grum County by Fort Xialuke to the north. Grum is dominated by and administered from the city of Eltisweiss, the seat of House Grum. Several other villages populate the region, which is surrounded by natural mountainous defenses to its west, south, and east.

heroes.desc_id: Ymir adalah kurcaci pengrajin yang ahli soal senjata dan peralatan. Omongannya ceplas-ceplos tapi tangannya terampil. Temui dia di Eltisweiss.
heroes.desc_en: Ymir is a dwarf craftsman who knows weapons and gear inside out. Blunt in speech, skilled with his hands. Meet him in Eltisweiss.

gameplay.recruitment: Ymir | Castle Ruins | Joins automatically upon establishing the Alliance army.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Sumire
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — salah satu penyintas yang bergabung.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — one of the survivors who joins.
heroes.desc_id: Sumire adalah pendekar wanita dari timur dengan teknik pedang yang indah sekaligus mematikan. Dingin di luar, setia di dalam. Rekrut dia di Eltisweiss.
heroes.desc_en: Sumire is a swordswoman from the east with a blade technique as beautiful as it is deadly. Cold outside, loyal within. Recruit her in Eltisweiss.

gameplay.recruitment: Sumire | Castle Ruins | Joins automatically upon establishing the Alliance army.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Cassandra
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — bergabung dengan pasukan baru.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — joins the fledgling force.
heroes.desc_id: Cassandra adalah wanita misterius dengan masa lalu yang jarang diceritakan. Auranya bikin penasaran siapa pun yang melihat. Cari dia di Eltisweiss setelah progres cerita tertentu.
heroes.desc_en: Cassandra is a mysterious woman with a past she rarely speaks of. Her aura intrigues everyone who meets her. Find her in Eltisweiss after certain story progress.

gameplay.recruitment: Cassandra | Castle Ruins | Joins automatically upon establishing the Alliance army.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Kogen
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — setelah bertarung melawannya di Abandoned Mines, dia dan gengnya bergabung saat evakuasi Eltisweiss.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — after fighting him in the Abandoned Mines, he and his gang join during the Eltisweiss evacuation.
heroes.desc_id: Kogen adalah ninja lincah yang bergerak tanpa suara. Ahli menyelinap dan menyerang dari bayangan. Ajak dia gabung saat menjelajah Eltisweiss.
heroes.desc_en: Kogen is an agile ninja who moves without a sound. A master of stealth and strikes from shadow. Invite him along while exploring Eltisweiss.

gameplay.recruitment: Kogen | Castle Ruins | Joins automatically upon establishing the Alliance army.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Yuthus
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — bergabung bersama Kogen dan Zabi.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — joins alongside Kogen and Zabi.
heroes.desc_id: Yuthus adalah pemuda pendiam dengan kemampuan bertarung yang solid. Nggak banyak gaya, yang penting hasil. Temui dia di Eltisweiss.
heroes.desc_en: Yuthus is a quiet young man with solid combat skills. No flash, just results. Meet him in Eltisweiss.

gameplay.recruitment: Yuthus | Castle Ruins | Joins automatically upon establishing the Alliance army.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Zabi
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — bergabung bersama Kogen dan Yuthus.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — joins alongside Kogen and Yuthus.
heroes.desc_id: Zabi adalah petualang santai yang doyan cari pengalaman baru. Selalu bawa suasana rame ke mana pun pergi. Rekrut dia di Eltisweiss.
heroes.desc_en: Zabi is a laid-back adventurer always hunting for new experiences. He brings a lively mood wherever he goes. Recruit him in Eltisweiss.

gameplay.recruitment: Zabi | Castle Ruins | Joins automatically upon establishing the Alliance army.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Gocteau
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — penyintas yang bergabung di tahap ini.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — another survivor who joins at this stage.
heroes.desc_id: Gocteau adalah ketua serikat yang karismatik dan jadi tangan kanan Nowa di markas. Urusan misi dan organisasi, serahkan ke dia. Dia gabung otomatis saat Aliansi mulai membangun Castle HQ.
heroes.desc_en: Gocteau is a charismatic guild leader who becomes Nowa's right hand at HQ. Missions and organization — leave them to him. He joins automatically when the Alliance starts building Castle HQ.

gameplay.recruitment: Gocteau | Headquarters | Joins automatically upon obtaining the headquarters.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Iris
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — bergabung dengan pasukan kecil.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — joins the small army.
heroes.desc_id: Iris adalah arsitek jenius yang merancang pembangunan Castle HQ. Cerewet soal detail, tapi hasilnya selalu memukau. Dia gabung otomatis saat fase pembangunan markas dimulai.
heroes.desc_en: Iris is the genius architect designing Castle HQ's construction. Fussy about details, but her results always stun. She joins automatically when the HQ building phase begins.

gameplay.recruitment: Iris | Headquarters | Joins automatically upon obtaining the headquarters.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Caine
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — direkrut bersama rombongan.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine/Town HQ — recruited as part of the bunch.
heroes.desc_id: Caine adalah bendahara markas yang teliti ngurus dana dan gudang. Orangnya kaku soal angka, tapi justru itu yang bikin markas jalan. Dia gabung otomatis bareng tim pembangunan HQ.
heroes.desc_en: Caine is the HQ treasurer who meticulously manages funds and the warehouse. Strict about numbers, and that's exactly what keeps HQ running. He joins automatically with the HQ building team.

gameplay.recruitment: Caine | Headquarters | Joins automatically upon obtaining the headquarters.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Martha
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — di timur reruntuhan plaza, bibi Nowa.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — east of the plaza ruins, Nowa's auntie.
heroes.desc_id: Martha adalah peternak ramah yang ngurus Pasturage di markas. Sayang sama hewan-hewannya kayak keluarga sendiri. Rekrut dia lalu bangun Pasturage di Drafting Studio.
heroes.desc_en: Martha is a friendly rancher who runs the Pasturage at HQ. She loves her animals like family. Recruit her, then build the Pasturage at the Drafting Studio.

gameplay.recruitment: Martha | Headquarters | Speak to Martha on the east side of the headquarters.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Ormond
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine — lewat pintu belakang lantai 1 HQ (kuburan), turun ke sumur, lalu ke barat daya sampai pintu keluar tak bertanda.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine — through the back door on HQ's first floor (graveyard), down the well, then southwest to an unmarked exit.
heroes.desc_id: Ormond adalah mandor tambang kekar yang ngurus Quarry. Suaranya menggelegar, kerjanya beres. Rekrut dia buat membuka Quarry di markas.
heroes.desc_en: Ormond is a burly mine foreman who runs the Quarry. Booming voice, solid work. Recruit him to open the Quarry at HQ.

gameplay.recruitment: Ormond | Abandoned Mine | Bring 3 Iron Ore to Ormond. He is located immediately to the south of the new shortcut by the ladder to the headquarters.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Hiro
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine — di bagian pilar berputar; bisa direkrut setelah Town HQ Level 2.
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine — in the looping pillars section; recruitable after Town HQ Level 2.
heroes.desc_id: Hiro adalah pedagang serba-bisa yang buka Tool Shop di markas. Ramah dan selalu punya barang yang kamu butuhkan. Rekrut dia lalu bangun Tool Shop.
heroes.desc_en: Hiro is a versatile merchant who opens the Tool Shop at HQ. Friendly, and always stocks what you need. Recruit him, then build the Tool Shop.

gameplay.recruitment: Hiro | Abandoned Mine | Speak to Hiro in his usual spot.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Galdorf
heroes.recruit_id: Abandoned Mine — di ruang pertama (dari pintu world map); bawakan Paleknight Mail (loot di bekas lokasi Ormond atau Proving Grounds).
heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mine — in the first chamber (from the world map entrance); bring a Paleknight Mail (looted where Ormond was, or in Proving Grounds).
heroes.desc_id: Galdorf adalah veteran perang bertubuh besar dengan pengalaman segudang. Cerita medan perangnya nggak ada habisnya. Temui dia di salah satu kota buat ngajak gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Galdorf is a large-bodied war veteran with a wealth of experience. His battlefield stories never end. Meet him in one of the towns to invite him along.

gameplay.recruitment: Galdorf | Abandoned Mine | Speak to Galdorf at the entrance to the mine and bring him the Palenight Mail , which can be found next to Ormond's spot in the mine. The armor cannot be equipped at the time of recruiting.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Falward
heroes.recruit_id: Altverden Village — di dalam balai kota; berikan 15 Healing Herbs untuk menyembuhkan warga.
heroes.recruit_en: Altverden Village — inside the town hall; give 15 Healing Herbs to cure the townsfolk.
heroes.desc_id: Falward adalah kesatria tenang yang memegang teguh kode kehormatan. Setia dan bisa diandalkan di garis depan. Cari dia di kota-kota yang kamu kunjungi.
heroes.desc_en: Falward is a calm knight who upholds his code of honor. Loyal and dependable on the front line. Find him in the towns you visit.

gameplay.recruitment: Falward | Altverden Village | Speak to Falward in the village meeting hall and hand over 15 Healing Herbs .; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Frida
heroes.recruit_id: Werne Village — mengelola kios di kiri nenek Yume.
heroes.recruit_en: Werne Village — managing her stall to the left of Yume's grandma.
heroes.desc_id: Frida adalah pandai besi wanita yang ahli bikin armor kokoh. Orangnya blak-blakan tapi jujur soal kualitas. Rekrut dia buat membuka Armor Shop di markas.
heroes.desc_en: Frida is a female blacksmith skilled at forging sturdy armor. Blunt but honest about quality. Recruit her to open the Armor Shop at HQ.

gameplay.recruitment: Frida | Werne Village | Speak to Frida at her stall in the south-west of the village..; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Wyler
heroes.recruit_id: Bounty Hill — jelajahi area bawah untuk mencari adiknya Marin; setelah ketemu, keduanya bergabung.
heroes.recruit_en: Bounty Hill — explore the lower areas searching for his sister Marin; once found, both join.
heroes.desc_id: Wyler adalah pemuda bersemangat yang pengin buktiin dirinya di medan perang. Antusiasmenya nular ke sekitar. Ajak dia gabung saat menjelajah.
heroes.desc_en: Wyler is an eager young man out to prove himself on the battlefield. His enthusiasm is contagious. Invite him along while exploring.

gameplay.recruitment: Wyler | Bounty Hill | Speak to Wyler at the entrance to Bounty Hill and complete the mission to find his sister.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Marin
heroes.recruit_id: Bounty Hill — bergabung bersama kakaknya Wyler.
heroes.recruit_en: Bounty Hill — joins alongside her brother Wyler.
heroes.desc_id: Marin adalah gadis ceria yang selalu bawa keceriaan ke mana pun pergi. Di balik tawanya ada keberanian asli. Temui dia di kota buat direkrut.
heroes.desc_en: Marin is a cheerful girl who brings joy wherever she goes. Behind her laughter lies true courage. Meet her in town to recruit her.

gameplay.recruitment: Marin | Bounty Hill | Speak to Wyler at the entrance to Bounty Hill and complete the mission to find his sister.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Kerrin
heroes.recruit_id: Dappled Forest — di gubuk penebang kayu sisi kanan pintu masuk; bawakan lumber agar mau bergabung.
heroes.recruit_en: Dappled Forest — inside a woodcutter's hut on the right as you enter; bring lumber to recruit her.
heroes.desc_id: Kerrin adalah penebang kayu kekar yang ngurus Woodcutter's Cabin. Kapaknya nggak cuma buat pohon. Rekrut dia buat membuka Woodcutter's Cabin di markas.
heroes.desc_en: Kerrin is a burly lumberjack who runs the Woodcutter's Cabin. His axe isn't just for trees. Recruit him to open the Woodcutter's Cabin at HQ.

gameplay.recruitment: Kerrin | Dappled Forest | Bring 20 Lumber to Kerrin at her hut east of the entrance.; Hoist the Alliance Banner

heroes.name: Gieran
heroes.recruit_id: The Greatwood (East) — lawan monster sampai dapat Rune of Conservation sebagai loot.
heroes.recruit_en: The Greatwood (East) — battle monsters until you loot the Rune of Conservation.
heroes.desc_id: Gieran adalah pemburu tenang yang ahli membaca jejak dan medan. Nggak banyak omong, tapi observasinya tajam. Cari dia di sekitar daerah hutan.
heroes.desc_en: Gieran is a calm hunter skilled at reading tracks and terrain. Quiet, but sharply observant. Find him around forested areas.

gameplay.recruitment: Gieran | The Greatwood – East | Speak to Gieran in the forest. Defeat the Ancient Seed sub-boss and bring him the Rune of Conservation it drops.; The Village of the Treefolk

heroes.name: Kallathor
heroes.recruit_id: Treefolk Village — memimpin tim ke Greatwood; bergabung permanen setelah dungeon Proving Grounds selesai.
heroes.recruit_en: Treefolk Village — leads your team into the Greatwood; joins permanently after the Proving Grounds dungeon.
heroes.desc_id: Kallathor adalah prajurit gagah dengan gaya bertarung agresif. Pantang mundur sekali maju. Temui dia buat ngajak gabung ke Aliansi.
heroes.desc_en: Kallathor is a gallant warrior with an aggressive fighting style. He never backs down once committed. Meet him to invite him to the Alliance.

gameplay.recruitment: Kallathor | Treefolk Village | Joins automatically following plot events in the Proving Grounds .; The Proving Grounds

heroes.name: Chron
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — muncul di jalan utama kota setelah event Treefolk Village/Proving Grounds.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — appears on the town's main path after the Treefolk Village/Proving Grounds events.
heroes.desc_id: Chron adalah pencatat rajin yang ngurus Achievement Society di markas. Semua pencapaianmu dicatat rapi sama dia. Rekrut dia lalu bangun Achievement Society.
heroes.desc_en: Chron is a diligent record-keeper who runs the Achievement Society at HQ. He logs all your accomplishments neatly. Recruit him, then build the Achievement Society.

gameplay.recruitment: Chron | Headquarters | Speak to Chron at the entrance to the Headquarters .; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Squash
heroes.recruit_id: Treefolk Village — di depan trading post; kembali ke Dappled Forest, lawan Phantombird sampai dapat Sparklestone.
heroes.recruit_en: Treefolk Village — in front of the trading post; return to Dappled Forest and fight Phantombirds until a Sparklestone drops.
heroes.desc_id: Squash adalah pedagang aksesori yang cerewet tapi jeli soal barang bagus. Koleksinya lengkap. Rekrut dia buat membuka Accessory Shop.
heroes.desc_en: Squash is a chatty accessory merchant with a sharp eye for quality goods. His collection is complete. Recruit him to open the Accessory Shop.

gameplay.recruitment: Squash | Treefolk Village | Speak to Squash beside the town's Trading Post. Bring him a Sparklestone . The item is dropped by Phantombird s and Red Wyvern s in the Dappled Forest .; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Pastole
heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne East — temui setelah Proving Grounds, lewat jalur Greatwood (South).
heroes.recruit_en: Twinhorne East — meet after the Proving Grounds via the Greatwood (South) path.
heroes.desc_id: Pastole adalah pemburu ulung yang ngurus Hunter's Cabin. Hasil buruannya selalu berkualitas. Rekrut dia buat membuka Hunter's Cabin di markas.
heroes.desc_en: Pastole is a master hunter who runs the Hunter's Cabin. His hunts always yield quality goods. Recruit him to open the Hunter's Cabin at HQ.

gameplay.recruitment: Pastole | Twinhorne East | Speak to Pastole next to the town's tool shop.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Mariette
heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne East — dia kehilangan charm saat lari dari Rabbit Archwitch; kembali ke Greatwood (South), lawan Rabbit Archwitch dan loot peti dengan Attack/Gimmick.
heroes.recruit_en: Twinhorne East — she lost her charm fleeing a Rabbit Archwitch; return to Greatwood (South), fight Rabbit Archwitches and loot chests with Attack/Gimmick.
heroes.desc_id: Mariette adalah kutu buku yang cinta mati sama koleksi bukunya. Ngurus Library di markas dengan penuh dedikasi. Rekrut dia lalu bangun Library.
heroes.desc_en: Mariette is a bookworm devoted to her collection. She runs the HQ Library with full dedication. Recruit her, then build the Library.

gameplay.recruitment: Mariette | Twinhorne East | Speak to Mariette and retreive her Mariette's Charm . It is obtained through a Treasure Chest gimmick in battle against a Rabbit Archwitch in the The Greatwood – South .; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Perrielle
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — bangsawan House Grum; resmi bergabung setelah negosiasi dengan pejabat Hishahn.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — noble scion of House Grum; officially joins after negotiations with Hishahn officials.
heroes.desc_id: Perrielle adalah Lady penguasa Euchrisse, Negeri Air. Anggun, bijaksana, dan disegani rakyatnya. Dia bergabung dengan Aliansi seiring berjalannya cerita di Greatwood.
heroes.desc_en: Perrielle is the Lady ruling Euchrisse, the Land of Water. Graceful, wise, and revered by her people. She joins the Alliance as the Greatwood story unfolds.

gameplay.recruitment: Perrielle Grum | Hishahn | Joins automatically at the inn in Hishahn.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Janquis
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — bergabung bersama Perrielle.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — joins alongside Perrielle.
heroes.desc_id: Janquis adalah ilmuwan eksentrik yang terobsesi sama penelitian rune-lens. Ngomongnya cepat dan penuh teori aneh. Temui dia buat ngajak gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Janquis is an eccentric scholar obsessed with rune-lens research. He talks fast, full of strange theories. Meet him to invite him along.

gameplay.recruitment: Janquis | Hishahn | Joins automatically at the inn in Hishahn.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Kurtz
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — di tengah kota, dia mencari resep; punya arc opsional dan mini-game cooking contest.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — at the city center, looking for a recipe; has his own optional arc and cooking minigame.
heroes.desc_id: Kurtz adalah koki flamboyan yang perfeksionis soal rasa. Standarnya tinggi, masakannya luar biasa. Rekrut dia buat membuka Restaurant di markas.
heroes.desc_en: Kurtz is a flamboyant chef who's a perfectionist about flavor. High standards, extraordinary dishes. Recruit him to open the Restaurant at HQ.

gameplay.recruitment: Kurtz | Hishahn | Speak to Kurtz outside the Smithy, then travel to the Treefolk Village and speak to the adult Treefolk by the Trading Post to receive the Grilled Tutuva Recipe . The recipe cannot be obtained until Kurtz is spoken to; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Huang
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — bergabung setelah berhasil menangkap ikan Wheel-eyed Bream yang sulit.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — joins once you catch the elusive Wheel-eyed Bream fish.
heroes.desc_id: Huang adalah nelayan tua yang santai dan bijak soal memancing. Kasih dia Wheel Eye Bream di Hishahn biar dia mau gabung dan buka Fishing Spot.
heroes.desc_en: Huang is a laid-back old fisherman, wise in the ways of angling. Give him a Wheel Eye Bream in Hishahn and he'll join, opening the Fishing Spot.

gameplay.recruitment: Huang | Hishahn | After receiving the Bamboo Rod from Huang in Hishahn , speak to him near the Appraiser's Shop to the east. Speak to him again after catching a Wheel-Eye Bream . The fish can be caught at the Euchrisse fishing spot at any time, including before speaking to Huang in the city.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Nell
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — di belakang kios bagian barat laut kota.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — behind the stall in the northwestern part of the city.
heroes.desc_id: Nell adalah pedagang ransel yang rapi dan terorganisir. Urusan penyimpanan dan perbekalan, dia ahlinya. Rekrut dia buat membuka Stowpack Shop.
heroes.desc_en: Nell is a neat, organized pack merchant. Storage and supplies are her expertise. Recruit her to open the Stowpack Shop.

gameplay.recruitment: Nell | Hishahn | Speak to Nell, who is hidden behind some stalls at the north-west exit to the city.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Riufan
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — di depan kincir air; tantang dan kalahkan dia (butuh Nowa sekitar level 33).
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — in front of a waterwheel; challenge and defeat him (needs Nowa around level 33).
heroes.desc_id: Riufan adalah petarung misterius dengan masa lalu kelam. Gerakannya cepat dan efisien tanpa basa-basi. Cari dia di kota-kota buat ngajak gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Riufan is a mysterious fighter with a dark past. Fast, efficient movements, no nonsense. Find him in the towns to invite him along.

gameplay.recruitment: Riufan | Hishahn | Speak to Riufan in the north side when Nowa is level 32 or higher. Defeat Riufan in a one-on-one battle.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Carrie
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — membuka mekanik teleportasi/fast travel.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — unlocks the teleportation/fast travel mechanic.
heroes.desc_id: Carrie adalah penyihir ceria yang ngasih kemampuan fast travel — wajib rekrut! Dengan dia, pindah-pindah kota jadi gampang banget. Temui dia di petualanganmu dan ajak gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Carrie is a cheerful mage who grants fast travel — a must-recruit! With her, hopping between towns becomes effortless. Meet her on your adventure and invite her along.

gameplay.recruitment: Carrie | Hishahn | Encounter Carrie three times while crossing the city's bridges (northwest, northeast, southeast). Note: Although Carrie is not an automatic recruit, she is a mandatory one. The player cannot progress through Hishahn Old Town without her, meaning she can not be skipped on low recruit runs.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water
