heroes.name: Paquia
heroes.recruit_id: Arenside — bersama Eggfoot-nya; kumpulkan 5 Plain Eggs (drop dari Eggfoot di world map luar HQ).
heroes.recruit_en: Arenside — with her Eggfoot companion; collect 5 Plain Eggs (dropped by Eggfoots on the world map outside HQ).
heroes.desc_id: Paquia adalah perawat eggfoot yang penyayang dan telaten. Makhluk-makhluk bulat itu nurut banget sama dia. Rekrut dia (bareng Mandie) buat membuka Racing Stables.
heroes.desc_en: Paquia is a caring, patient eggfoot caretaker. Those round creatures obey her completely. Recruit her (along with Mandie) to open the Racing Stables.

gameplay.recruitment: Paquia | Arenside | Speak to Paquia by the eastern bridge and bring her 5 Regular Eggs .; New Forces

heroes.name: Mandie
heroes.recruit_id: Arenside — bergabung sekitar waktu yang sama dengan Paquia.
heroes.recruit_en: Arenside — joins around the same time as Paquia.
heroes.desc_id: Mandie adalah partner Paquia yang energik dalam mengurus eggfoot. Kompak banget kerja berdua. Rekrut dia buat membuka Racing Stables di markas.
heroes.desc_en: Mandie is Paquia's energetic partner in caring for eggfoot. They work perfectly as a pair. Recruit her to open the Racing Stables at HQ.

gameplay.recruitment: Mandie | Arenside | Speak to Paquia by the eastern bridge and bring her 5 Regular Eggs .; New Forces

heroes.name: Glen
heroes.recruit_id: Arenside — di rumah bagian barat; kalahkan dia dalam card match.
heroes.recruit_en: Arenside — at the house in the western part; beat him in a card match.
heroes.desc_id: Glen adalah pemain kartu ulung yang tenang dan licik dalam strategi. Nggak pernah main tanpa rencana matang. Rekrut dia buat membuka Card Shop dan adu kartu.
heroes.desc_en: Glen is a master card player — calm and cunning in strategy. He never plays without a solid plan. Recruit him to open the Card Shop and duel.

gameplay.recruitment: Glen | Arenside | Speak to Glen in west Arenside and defeat him at a Card Battle.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Pieter
heroes.recruit_id: Werne Village — di bagian barat laut kota.
heroes.recruit_en: Werne Village — in the northwestern part of town.
heroes.desc_id: Pieter adalah petani ulet yang ngurus Farm di markas. Tangannya dingin buat urusan tanaman. Rekrut dia lalu bangun Farm.
heroes.desc_en: Pieter is a hardworking farmer who runs the Farm at HQ. He has a green thumb for crops. Recruit him, then build the Farm.

gameplay.recruitment: Pieter | Werne Village | Speak to Pieter in the northwest farming plot of Werne Village .; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.name: Isha
heroes.recruit_id: Eltisweiss — karakter dari Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising, di dekat air mancur plaza; selesaikan 3 tugasnya: cari kucing hilang (barat daya kota), dapatkan Cockatrice Egg (Mountain Path Homeward, loot peti dengan Attack/Gimmick), antar paket ke Arenside.
heroes.recruit_en: Eltisweiss — a character from Eiyuden Chronicle: Rising, by the plaza fountain; complete her 3 tasks: find the lost cat (southwest city), obtain a Cockatrice Egg (Mountain Path Homeward, loot chest with Attack/Gimmick), deliver a package to Arenside.
heroes.desc_id: Isha adalah penjabat walikota New Nevaeh dan penyihir berbakat — salah satu protagonis Rising. Cerdas, bertanggung jawab, dan peduli sama kotanya. Dia bergabung dengan Aliansi di tengah cerita.
heroes.desc_en: Isha is the acting mayor of New Nevaeh and a gifted mage — one of Rising's protagonists. Smart, responsible, and devoted to her town. She joins the Alliance mid-story.

gameplay.recruitment: Isha | Eltisweiss | Speak with Isha at the southeastern fountain in the city and complete her three tasks. The black cat can be found in the southwest corner of the city. After this, Isha will gift the Stamp Card and additional requests. The Cockatrice Egg is obtained through a Treasure Chest gimmick in battle against a Cockatrice (adult) on the Mountain Path Homeward . The Package for Arenside is delivered to the General Store in Arenside . Speak to Isha again and she will join the party.; New Forces

heroes.name: Douglas
heroes.recruit_id: Eltisweiss — di toko pandai besi; berikan 10x Iron Ore.
heroes.recruit_en: Eltisweiss — at the blacksmith's shop; give him 10x Iron Ore.
heroes.desc_id: Douglas adalah pandai besi bertangan kuat yang ngurus Smithy. Tempaannya bikin senjata makin tajam. Rekrut dia buat membuka Smithy di markas.
heroes.desc_en: Douglas is a strong-armed blacksmith who runs the Smithy. His forging makes weapons sharper. Recruit him to open the Smithy at HQ.

gameplay.recruitment: Douglas | Eltisweiss | Speak with Douglas at the Smithy on the west side of the city. Mine 10x Iron Ore after he requests the materials. Iron Ore collected and deposited at Headquarters still counts towards the total.; New Forces

heroes.name: Larla
heroes.recruit_id: Eltisweiss — di penginapan; kemungkinan bergabung setelah tim menyelesaikan misi dengan rating 'Critical Success'.
heroes.recruit_en: Eltisweiss — at the inn; likely joins once a team completes a task with a 'Critical Success' rating.
heroes.desc_id: Larla adalah gadis misterius dengan kemampuan unik yang belum banyak diketahui. Auranya bikin penasaran. Temui dia di perjalanan buat ngajak gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Larla is a mysterious girl with little-known unique abilities. Her aura intrigues. Meet her on your travels to invite her along.

gameplay.recruitment: Larla | Eltisweiss | Speak with Larla at the inn once the Headquarters is at Level 2 or higher, the Mission Guild is established, and at least one "Epic Success" mission rating has been achieved.; New Forces

heroes.name: Maureus
heroes.recruit_id: Mountain Path Homeward — jalur barat laut; dia mencari anggota skuad yang kuat (butuh stat strength/magic tinggi, ~200).
heroes.recruit_en: Mountain Path Homeward — northwestern pathway; he's looking for a powerful squad member (needs high strength/magic, ~200).
heroes.desc_id: Maureus adalah cendekiawan tua yang bijak dan penuh pengetahuan sejarah. Ceritanya soal masa lalu Allraan menarik banget. Ajak dia gabung saat bertemu.
heroes.desc_en: Maureus is a wise old scholar full of historical knowledge. His tales of Allraan's past are fascinating. Invite him when you meet.

gameplay.recruitment: Maureus | Mountain Path Homeward | Speak to Maureus at the north-western dead-end with a character with 250 or higher base MP in the party. Falward , Francesca , and Mellore will reach this at level 33.; New Forces

heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — related to meeting B'baba and using the Divination Parlor.
heroes.desc_id: Faye adalah gadis peramal yang jadi kunci buat menemukan B'baba. Mulai quest-nya di tembok barat kastil, selesaikan, dan dia bakal gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Faye is a fortune-telling girl who's the key to finding B'baba. Start her quest at the castle's west rampart, complete it, and she'll join.

gameplay.recruitment: Faye | Headquarters | After recruiting B'baba in Daphan Village , visit B'baba in the far eastern room at the Headquarters first floor. She will guide the player to Yusuke (Castle Rooftop), then Francesca (Castle 1F western-most room), and finally Yume (Castle 2F, outside the Great Hall). If these three characters are not recruited, Faye can not be recruited until they have been. After visiting Yume, Faye will join the party.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.recruit_id: Daphan Village — dia memberi petunjuk lokasi calon sekutu lain.
heroes.recruit_en: Daphan Village — she gives hints about other potential allies' whereabouts.
heroes.desc_id: B'baba adalah peramal tua yang bisa melacak lokasi calon sekutu — berguna banget buat ngelengkapin 120 bintang! Selesaikan quest Faye dan temui dia di rumah barat laut Daphan.
heroes.desc_en: B'baba is an old fortune-teller who can track the locations of potential allies — incredibly useful for completing all 120 stars! Finish Faye's quest and meet her at the northwest house in Daphan.

gameplay.recruitment: B'baba | Daphan Village | After visiting Hishahn for the first time, encounter Faye on the path north of the Trading House at Headquarters . Speak with B'baba in her abode in the northwest of the village.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — direkrut setelah memenangkan army battle di Hishahn.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — recruited upon winning the army battle at Hishahn.
heroes.desc_id: Melridge adalah sarjana kutu buku yang haus ilmu pengetahuan. Selalu bawa catatan ke mana-mana. Temui dia buat ngajak gabung ke markas.
heroes.desc_en: Melridge is a bookish scholar thirsty for knowledge. Always carries notes everywhere. Meet him to invite him to HQ.

gameplay.recruitment: Melridge | Headquarters | Melridge joins automatically after consulting in the Headquarters 's Great Hall.; The Assassinated Emperor

heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — joins around the same time as Melridge.
heroes.desc_id: Bernard (Barnard Sawad) adalah pemandu gurun yang hafal tiap jengkal padang pasir. Orangnya santai tapi navigasinya akurat. Dia gabung saat cerita membawamu ke Shandar Ridge.
heroes.desc_en: Bernard (Barnard Sawad) is a desert guide who knows every inch of the sands. Easygoing, but his navigation is spot-on. He joins when the story takes you to Shandar Ridge.

gameplay.recruitment: Barnard Sawad | Headquarters | Barnard joins automatically after consulting in the Headquarters 's Great Hall.; The Assassinated Emperor

heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — officially joins the alliance after the events at Hishahn.
heroes.desc_id: Seign Kesling adalah perwira Kekaisaran Galdea dan protagonis kedua — disiplin, cerdas, dan setia pada tugasnya. Nasib mempertemukannya dengan Nowa di tengah perang. Dia bergabung mengikuti alur cerita.
heroes.desc_en: Seign Kesling is an officer of the Galdean Empire and the second protagonist — disciplined, sharp, and dutiful. Fate crosses his path with Nowa's amid the war. He joins following the story.

gameplay.recruitment: Seign Kesling | Headquarters | Seign joins automatically after consulting in the Headquarters 's Great Hall.; The Assassinated Emperor

heroes.desc_en: Pohl is Seign's loyal aide, always ready at his side. His devotion to Seign is unquestionable. He joins following the Empire storyline.

heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — Seign's lieutenant, always by his side.

heroes.desc_en: Valentin is a stern, principled Imperial officer. Behind the uniform lies inner conflict about this war. He joins as the story progresses.

heroes.desc_id: Hildi adalah perwira Kekaisaran yang dingin dan efisien — wajahnya yang kamu lihat di icon aplikasi ini! Profesional total di medan tugas. Dia bergabung mengikuti alur cerita.
heroes.desc_en: Hildi is a cold, efficient Imperial officer — the face you see on this app's icon! Totally professional in the field. She joins following the story.

heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — at the western exit of your base, appearing injured.
heroes.desc_id: Leon adalah pemuda idealis yang percaya perang harus diakhiri dengan cara yang benar. Semangatnya membara. Temui dia buat ngajak gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Leon is an idealistic young man who believes war must end the right way. His spirit burns bright. Meet him to invite him along.

gameplay.recruitment: Leon Lasude | Headquarters | Once the Headquarters is at Lv. 2 or above, speak to Leon at the western entrance.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.recruit_id: Dappled Forest — muncul setelah Mission Guild dibangun dan bagian kedua Dappled Forest bisa dijelajahi.
heroes.recruit_en: Dappled Forest — appears once the Mission Guild is built and the second Dappled Forest section is traversable.
heroes.desc_id: Fume adalah gadis misterius yang gerakannya secepat asap. Nggak banyak yang tahu asal-usulnya. Cari dia di kota-kota buat direkrut.
heroes.desc_en: Fume is a mysterious girl who moves as fast as smoke. Few know her origins. Find her in the towns to recruit her.

gameplay.recruitment: Fume | Dappled Forest | Speak with Fume east of the second save point in the forest once the Headquarters is at Level 2 or higher and the Mission Guild is established.; New Forces

heroes.name: Jorhan
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — di depan trading post; bicara dengannya, lalu ke Shandar Ridge/gurun Dabavin, lawan Scarab sampai dapat Unknown Antique, appraisal untuk tahu itu Yellow Rose Censer, serahkan ke Jorhan.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — in front of the trading post; talk to him, then go through Shandar Ridge to the Dabavin desert, fight Scarabs until an Unknown Antique drops, appraise it to reveal a Yellow Rose Censer, hand it to Jorhan.
heroes.desc_id: Jorhan adalah petarung berpengalaman dengan gaya bertarung brutal tapi efektif. Ditakuti lawan, dihormati kawan. Ajak dia gabung saat bertemu.
heroes.desc_en: Jorhan is an experienced fighter with a brutal but effective style. Feared by foes, respected by allies. Invite him when you meet.

gameplay.recruitment: Jorhan Gavulet | Hishahn | Speak with Jorhan outside the Trading Post in the city. There is an additional scene if Perrielle is in the party when speaking with him. If not, there will be a scene with the same information available in Perrielle's room at the Headquarters . The antique Jorhan seeks, the Yellow Rose Censer can be dropped as an Unknown Antique by Scarab s in the Eastern Desert .; New Forces

heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — di dekat pintu keluar kiri bawah setelah event besar; tantang balapan (butuh speed Nowa ~165, pakai Rune of Swift Speed + Dash Boots).
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — near the lower-left exit after major events; challenge her to a race (needs Nowa ~165 speed, use Rune of Swift Speed + Dash Boots).
heroes.desc_id: Aire adalah gadis angin yang lincah dan bebas kayak hembusan angin. Susah ditebak, susah ditangkap. Temui dia di perjalanan.
heroes.desc_en: Aire is a free-spirited girl, nimble as the wind itself. Hard to predict, hard to catch. Meet her on your travels.

gameplay.recruitment: Aire | Hishahn | Speak to Aire near the southwestern entrance and beat her in a race. Nowa must have 135 SPD or higher, which he gains at level 36.; New Forces

heroes.name: Syd
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn — di depan toko pandai besi; baru mau bergabung setelah Town HQ level 3.
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn — in front of the blacksmith's shop; only joins once Town HQ reaches level 3.
heroes.desc_id: Syd adalah pengrajin ahli yang ngurus Workshop di markas. Tangannya terampil bikin peralatan tingkat tinggi. Rekrut dia lalu bangun Workshop.
heroes.desc_en: Syd is a master craftsman who runs the Workshop at HQ. His skilled hands make high-tier equipment. Recruit him, then build the Workshop.

gameplay.recruitment: Syd | Hishahn | The Headquarters must be at least Level 3. Speak to Syd outside the Smithy and bring him 1 Mystic Lumber , 1 Iron Ore , and 1 Dire Beastbone . The items must be in the stowpack, meaning the player will have to avoid depositing them at Headquarters.; Reunion

heroes.name: Hakugin
heroes.recruit_id: Daphan Village — datang dengan Mio di party.
heroes.recruit_en: Daphan Village — go with Mio in your party.
heroes.desc_id: Hakugin adalah pendekar bertopeng dari timur dengan teknik misterius. Dingin dan penuh rahasia. Cari dia buat ngajak gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Hakugin is a masked swordsman from the east with mysterious techniques. Cold and full of secrets. Find him to invite him along.

gameplay.recruitment: Hakugin | Daphan Village | Speak to Hakugin with Mio in the party east of the village entrance.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water

heroes.recruit_id: Daphan Village — bergabung setelah Mission Guild Gocteau dibangun di HQ.
heroes.recruit_en: Daphan Village — joins once Gocteau's Mission Guild is built in your HQ.
heroes.desc_id: Enoe adalah gadis pendiam dengan kekuatan tersembunyi yang besar. Jangan tertipu penampilannya yang kalem. Temui dia buat direkrut.
heroes.desc_en: Enoe is a quiet girl hiding great power. Don't be fooled by her calm appearance. Meet her to recruit her.

gameplay.recruitment: Enoe | Daphan Village | Speak with Enoe in the lower west side of the village once the Headquarters is at Level 2 or higher and the Mission Guild is established.; New Forces

heroes.name: Code L
heroes.recruit_id: Daphan Village — di dalam Rune Shop, tunjukkan Rune of Currents (loot dari boss Hishahn Old Town).
heroes.recruit_en: Daphan Village — inside the Rune Shop, show him a Rune of Currents (looted from the Hishahn Old Town boss).
heroes.desc_id: Code L adalah penjual rune yang eksentrik dan ngomong kayak robot. Koleksi rune-nya lengkap banget. Rekrut dia buat membuka Rune Shop.
heroes.desc_en: Code L is an eccentric rune vendor who talks like a robot. His rune collection is incredibly complete. Recruit him to open the Rune Shop.

gameplay.recruitment: Code L | Daphan Village | Speak to Code L inside the Rune Shop and bring him a Rune of Currents . This rune is first available as a guaranteed drop by the Pagurian boss in Hishahn Old Town . The rune cannot be equipped to a character when interacting with Code L but can be used freely afterwards.; Reveal Harlan's Schemes!

heroes.name: Lam

heroes.recruit_en: Daphan Village — BUG WARNING: don't enter Daphan Village before recruiting Riufan. After recruiting Riufan, talk to him at the HQ inn, then bring Riufan in your party on your first visit to Daphan Village.

heroes.recruit_id: Dabavin — ke Seaside Cavern, temukan Unknown Pocket Watch, appraisal lalu berikan padanya.
heroes.recruit_en: Dabavin — travel to the Seaside Cavern, find an Unknown Pocket Watch, have it appraised and give it to him.
heroes.desc_id: Rody adalah penaksir barang yang jeli melihat nilai tersembunyi. Nggak ada harta karun yang lolos dari matanya. Rekrut dia buat membuka Appraiser's Shop.
heroes.desc_en: Rody is a sharp appraiser who spots hidden value. No treasure escapes his eyes. Recruit him to open the Appraiser's Shop.

gameplay.recruitment: Rody | Dabavin | Speak to Rody next to the General Store with a Pearl Pocket-Watch on hand. Hand over the watch and he will join the party. A guaranteed watch can be found through a Treasure Chest gimmick in a random battle in the Eastern Desert or as a regular chest in the Seaside Cavern . Both appear as a Unknown Pocket-Watch and need to be appraised first.; New Forces

heroes.name: Cabana
heroes.recruit_id: Impershi'arc — di bagian timur kota.
heroes.recruit_en: Impershi'arc — at the eastern part of the city.
heroes.desc_id: Cabana adalah penjaga pemandian air panas yang ramah dan santai. Tempatnya paling enak buat istirahat. Rekrut dia buat membuka Hot Spring.
heroes.desc_en: Cabana is the friendly, laid-back keeper of the hot spring. His bathhouse is the best place to rest. Recruit him to open the Hot Spring.

gameplay.recruitment: Cabana | Impershi'arc | The Headquarters must be Level 2 or higher. Speak to Cabana just east of the Inn.; Across the Desert

heroes.name: Stadler
heroes.recruit_id: Impershi'arc — kalahkan dia dalam mock army battle.
heroes.recruit_en: Impershi'arc — defeat him in a mock army battle.
heroes.desc_id: Stadler adalah instruktur militer yang disiplin dan galak soal latihan. Hasilnya? Pasukanmu makin kuat. Rekrut dia buat membuka Drill Ground.
heroes.desc_en: Stadler is a disciplined military instructor, strict about training. The result? Your troops grow stronger. Recruit him to open the Drill Ground.

gameplay.recruitment: Stadler | Impershi'arc | Speak to Stadler in the main square and defeat him in a Mock Battle.; Across the Desert

heroes.name: Quinn
heroes.recruit_id: Impershi'arc — selesaikan objektif utama Impershi'arc dengan Nowa level 37, ikuti quest-nya ke Den of the Dunes, kejar boss Oyamatsumi.
heroes.recruit_en: Impershi'arc — complete the Impershi'arc main objective with Nowa at level 37, follow her quest to the Den of the Dunes, chase the Oyamatsumi boss.
heroes.desc_id: Quinn adalah pemuda cerdas dengan strategi yang tajam. Otaknya encer buat taktik perang. Cari dia buat ngajak gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Quinn is a sharp young man with keen strategies. His mind is quick with war tactics. Find him to invite him along.

gameplay.recruitment: Quinn | Impershi'arc | Nowa must be Level 37 or higher. Speak with Quinn outside the Inn, then again at the harbor. Complete the The Den of the Dunes by defeating the boss there three times, attacking it at each sinkhole it appears in.; Across the Desert

heroes.desc_id: Clarke adalah sutradara teater yang dramatis dan penuh gaya. Setiap ucapannya kayak naskah drama. Rekrut dia buat membuka Theater di markas.
heroes.desc_en: Clarke is a dramatic, stylish theater director. Every utterance sounds like a play script. Recruit him to open the Theater at HQ.

gameplay.recruitment: Clarke | Ardinale City | Talk to Clarke at the fountain south of Kesling Manor and show him The Star-Cross'd Lovers Script . The script can be purchased as a rare find (30% chance of appearing every 10 minutes) from the Ardinale Tool Shop.; Reunion

heroes.name: Dalton
heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne East — cukup ajak bicara untuk bergabung.
heroes.recruit_en: Twinhorne East — just talk to him to recruit.
heroes.desc_id: Dalton adalah petarung veteran yang sudah makan asam garam pertempuran. Pengalamannya berharga banget buat tim. Ajak dia gabung saat bertemu.
heroes.desc_en: Dalton is a veteran fighter seasoned by countless battles. His experience is priceless for the team. Invite him when you meet.

gameplay.recruitment: Dalton | Twinhorne East | The Headquarters must be at least Level 3 and the Mission Guild upgraded with Mission: Mission Task 1. Talk to Dalton outside the town's Inn. Sabine and Dalton will have additional dialogue if she is in the party.; To Norristar, the Western Nation

heroes.recruit_en: Abandoned Mines — via the well behind HQ's first floor, keep left and down the narrow tunnels; needs Town HQ Level 3 and upgraded Mission Guild.
heroes.desc_id: Durlan adalah raksasa lembut yang kekuatannya luar biasa. Hatinya selembut tenaganya yang kasar. Temui dia buat direkrut.
heroes.desc_en: Durlan is a gentle giant with extraordinary strength. His heart is as soft as his power is rough. Meet him to recruit him.

gameplay.recruitment: Durlan | Abandoned Mine | The Headquarters must be at least Level 3 and the Mission: Mission Task 1 facility upgrade developed. Enter the mines via the Headquarters well and talk to Duran in the western dead end.; Reunion

heroes.name: Milhu
heroes.recruit_id: Town HQ — bergabung di akhir mini-arc Seign.
heroes.recruit_en: Town HQ — joins at the conclusion of Seign's mini-arc.
heroes.desc_id: Milhu adalah pemanah lincah dengan bidikan yang nggak pernah meleset. Gerakannya secepat kilat. Cari dia buat ngajak gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Milhu is an agile archer whose aim never misses. He moves as fast as lightning. Find him to invite him along.

gameplay.recruitment: Mihlu | Headquarters | Mihlu joins automatically upon consulting on the current situation in the Great Hall.; Reunion

Datang ke New Nevaeh buat jalanin rite of passage keluarganya, eh malah keseret konflik besar Allraan. Di Hundred Heroes dia gabung setelah kamu menyelesaikan puzzle simbol di Runebarrows.
heroes.desc_en: CJ is a cheerful young treasure hunter with a strict code of honor — she refuses to steal from others. She came to New Nevaeh for her family's rite of passage but got swept into Allraan's greater conflict. In Hundred Heroes, she joins after you solve the symbol puzzles in the Runebarrows.

heroes.desc_en: Lilwn is a mysterious little girl with strange, intriguing abilities. Don't underestimate her. Find her on your travels.

heroes.recruit_id: Atrabalt — lord Hishahn yang plin-plan; resmi jadi sekutu saat cerita sampai Atrabalt.
heroes.recruit_en: Atrabalt — the indecisive lord of Hishahn; officially becomes an ally once the story reaches Atrabalt.
heroes.desc_id: Euma Sia adalah raja Euchrisse yang bijaksana dan disegani. Keputusan-keputusannya menentukan nasib negerinya. Dia bergabung dengan Aliansi seiring cerita di Greatwood.
heroes.desc_en: Euma Sia is the wise, revered king of Euchrisse. His decisions shape his nation's fate. He joins the Alliance as the Greatwood story unfolds.

gameplay.recruitment: Euma | Athrabalt | Euma will join automatically upon returning to Athrabalt Castle.; Yarnaan Falls

heroes.name: Kassius
heroes.recruit_id: Atrabalt — bergabung saat tuannya (Euma) bergabung.
heroes.recruit_en: Atrabalt — joins when his liege lord (Euma) does.
heroes.desc_id: Kassius adalah ahli strategi dingin yang selalu selangkah di depan lawan. Otaknya kayak komputer perang. Temui dia buat ngajak gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Kassius is a cold strategist always one step ahead of his foes. His mind works like a war computer. Meet him to invite him along.

gameplay.recruitment: Kassius | Athrabalt | Kassius will join automatically upon returning to Athrabalt Castle.; Yarnaan Falls

heroes.name: Foxiel
heroes.recruit_id: Atrabalt — di pasar timur depan kios; saat dia mendeskripsikan makanan, kembali ke restoran HQ, bicara dengan Kurtz untuk memasak Vegetable Milk Soup, serahkan padanya.
heroes.recruit_en: Atrabalt — at the eastern marketplace in front of a stall; when she describes a food, return to the HQ restaurant, speak with Kurtz to cook Vegetable Milk Soup, hand it to her.
heroes.desc_id: Foxiel adalah beastman rubah yang licik dan lincah. Senyumnya manis tapi otaknya muter terus. Ajak dia gabung saat bertemu.
heroes.desc_en: Foxiel is a sly, nimble fox beastman. Sweet smile, but his mind never stops turning. Invite him when you meet.

gameplay.recruitment: Foxiel | Athrabalt | Speak to Foxiel in the eastern square. Speak to Kurtz at Headquarters then return and speak to her once more with the Vegetable Milk Soup present in the inventory.; Yarnaan Falls

heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne West — bergabung otomatis karena event di Atrabalt dan Twinhorne West.
heroes.recruit_en: Twinhorne West — joins automatically due to events in Atrabalt and Twinhorne West.
heroes.desc_id: Yulin adalah penjaga penginapan yang ramah — dia adalah SAFE POINT berjalan! Selalu sedia saat kamu butuh istirahat dan simpan progres. Dia gabung otomatis di awal cerita.
heroes.desc_en: Yulin is a friendly innkeeper — he's a walking SAVE POINT! Always ready when you need rest and to save progress. He joins automatically early in the story.

gameplay.recruitment: Yulin | Twinhorne West | Yulin joins automatically during plot events in the town.; The General's Decision

heroes.name: Rohan
heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne West — di penginapan, ajak bicara.
heroes.recruit_en: Twinhorne West — at the inn, talk to him.
heroes.desc_id: Rohan adalah kesatria muda penuh idealisme yang percaya pada keadilan. Pedangnya selalu terhunus buat melindungi yang lemah. Cari dia buat ngajak gabung.
heroes.desc_en: Rohan is a young knight full of idealism who believes in justice. His sword is always drawn to protect the weak. Find him to invite him along.

gameplay.recruitment: Rohan | Twinhorne West | When the population of the Headquarters is over 5,000, speak to Rohan in the Twinhorne West In; Assault

heroes.name: Hogan
heroes.recruit_id: Twinhorne West — di dermaga; dia ingin kamu dapat minimal 50.000 baqua murni dari trading post (beli murah jual mahal: beli lukisan/ukiran di Ardinale City, jual lukisan di Hishahn, ukiran di Impershi'arc).
heroes.recruit_en: Twinhorne West — by the pier; he wants you to earn at least 50,000 baqua purely from trading posts (buy low sell high: buy paintings/carvings in Ardinale City, sell paintings in Hishahn, carvings in Impershi'arc).
heroes.desc_id: Hogan adalah pedagang ulung yang ngurus Trading Post di markas. Urusan jual-beli, dia jagonya. Rekrut dia lalu bangun Trading Post.
heroes.desc_en: Hogan is a master trader who runs the Trading Post at HQ. Buying and selling are his game. Recruit him, then build the Trading Post.

gameplay.recruitment: Hogan | Twinhorne West | Speak to Hogan at the end of the pier. The player now has to make make 50,000 profit in trading. Any earlier profit does not count towards this total. This challenge can be cheesed by buying up 50,000 worth of trade goods before speaking to Hogan, beginning the challenge from a base of 0, and then immediately selling everything to pass the threshold.; Assault

heroes.name: Momo
heroes.recruit_id: Hishahn/Seaside Cavern — di selatan jembatan toko Hishahn; selesaikan personal quest-nya di Seaside Caverns (buka barrier, kalahkan boss Kraken dengan Gimmick: turunkan air, pakai harpoon).
heroes.recruit_en: Hishahn/Seaside Cavern — south of the Hishahn shop bridge; complete his personal quest in the Seaside Caverns (unlock the barrier, defeat the Kraken boss using Gimmicks: lower water, use harpoon).
heroes.desc_id: Momo adalah gadis kecil periang yang selalu bawa keceriaan. Tawanya nular ke siapa pun di dekatnya. Temui dia buat direkrut.
heroes.desc_en: Momo is a bubbly little girl who always brings cheer. Her laughter is contagious to everyone near. Meet her to recruit her.

gameplay.recruitment: Momo | Hishahn | Cross the southeast bridge (south of the Smithy) to encounter Momo. Agree to Momo's request and defeat the Kraken boss in the Seaside Cavern .; Yarnaan Falls

heroes.desc_en: Galladur is a giant warrior in heavy armor with rock-solid defense. A walking wall, hard to breach. Invite him when you meet.

gameplay.recruitment: Galladur | Proving Grounds | Speak to Galladur outside the entrance to the room west of the corridor rotating device inside the Proving Grounds. Defeat the enemies that follow in one turn.; Yarnaan Falls

heroes.desc_id: Shixeen adalah pemain kartu misterius yang nggak pernah nunjukin kartunya... secara harfiah. Rekrut dia lewat dunia permainan kartu di markas.
heroes.desc_en: Shixeen is a mysterious card player who never shows his hand... literally. Recruit him through the card game scene at HQ.

gameplay.recruitment: Shixeen | Headquarters | Collect 120 individual cards and Shixeen will appear at Headquarters . Defeat her in a Card Battle to recruit her. This is technically possible with the second Card Shop upgrade, but would require getting 84 of the 88 unique cards in Extra Pack 1. It is easier to accomplish this later when more packs are available.; Euchrisse, the Land of Water
